title: Utility of Early Post‐Treatment Circulating Tumor Tissue Modified Viral HPV DNA Testing in HPV ‐Associated Oropharyngeal Cancer
abstract: ABSTRACT Background TTMV‐HPV DNA testing is prognostic during post‐treatment surveillance of HPV‐associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC), but the significance of testing before conventional 3‐month response assessment remains unclear. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 332 patients across 8 US sites with biopsy‐proven HPV‐associated OPSCC who underwent initial definitive treatment and had ≥ 1 TTMV‐HPV DNA test performed 1 to 89 days after treatment completion. Event‐free survival (EFS) was evaluated using a 90‐day landmark approach. Results The first TTMV‐HPV DNA test obtained 1–89 days after treatment was negative in 310 patients (93%), indeterminate in 3 (1%), and positive in 19 (6%). Among 59 patients with repeat testing after an initially negative result, 57 (97%) remained negative and 2 (3%) converted to positive; both patients who converted subsequently developed recurrence. Of 13 patients with an initially positive result and sufficient follow‐up for trajectory analysis, 6 (46%) subsequently resolved to negative and none developed recurrence, whereas 7 (54%) remained persistently positive and 6 (86%) developed recurrence. In a 90‐day landmark analysis, the last early post‐treatment TTMV‐HV DNA result was associated with subsequent event‐free survival. Conclusions TTMV‐HPV DNA testing during the 1–89‐day post‐treatment interval was associated with subsequent clinical outcomes in HPV‐associated OPSCC. Persistent positivity identified patients at increased risk, whereas positive results that resolved were not followed by recurrence in this cohort.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the utility of early post-treatment circulating tumor tissue modified viral HPV DNA testing in predicting clinical outcomes for patients with HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis of 332 patients with biopsy-proven HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma across 8 US sites who had ≥1 TTMV-HPV DNA test performed 1 to 89 days after treatment completion.
analysis.methods: Event-free survival was evaluated using a 90-day landmark approach, and patients were categorized based on their TTMV-HPV DNA test results.
analysis.main_results: The first TTMV-HPV DNA test was negative in 310 patients (93%), indeterminate in 3 (1%), and positive in 19 (6%). Among those with repeat testing after an initially negative result, 57 (97%) remained negative and 2 (3%) converted to positive, with both positive conversions associated with recurrence. Of 13 patients with initially positive results, 6 (46%) resolved to negative and none developed recurrence, while 7 (54%) remained persistently positive and 6 (86%) developed recurrence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that early post-treatment TTMV-HPV DNA testing could identify patients at increased risk of recurrence, with persistent positivity associated with worse outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that early post-treatment TTMV-HPV DNA testing may improve surveillance and risk stratification for patients with HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for selection bias, but the evidence is strong due to the large sample size and clear association between test results and clinical outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the utility of early post-treatment circulating tumor tissue modified viral HPV DNA testing in patients with HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer. The analysis included 332 patients across 8 US sites who had ≥1 test performed 1 to 89 days after treatment. Results showed that 93% of patients had negative tests, while 6% had positive results. Among those with repeat testing, 2 out of 59 patients who initially tested negative later became positive and both developed recurrence. Of 13 patients with initially positive results, 6 resolved to negative without recurrence, while 7 remained positive and 6 developed recurrence. The authors concluded that early TTMV-HPV DNA testing could identify patients at higher risk of recurrence, with persistent positivity linked to worse outcomes. The study's retrospective design may limit its generalizability, but the large sample size and clear associations provide strong evidence for the clinical relevance of this testing approach.

title: Quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy and pregnancy outcomes: nationwide, population based case-control study
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy and subsequent risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes. DESIGN: Nationwide, population based matched case-control study. SETTING: Population of Sweden, from 1 January 2006 to 31 December 2023. PARTICIPANTS: 624 713 singleton births among nulliparous women aged 16-35 years in Sweden between 2006 and 2023; 92 620 (14.8%) women had received quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes associated with quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination, with preterm birth (<37 weeks), including its subtypes, and spontaneous preterm birth as primary outcomes and preterm prelabour rupture of membranes, prelabour rupture of membranes, small for gestational age infant (<10th centile), severe small for gestational age infant (<3rd centile), stillbirth, and neonatal mortality as secondary outcomes. Effect modification by age at human papillomavirus vaccination was assessed. Conditional logistic regression was used to estimate odds ratios and adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). RESULTS: After adjustment for confounders, quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination was associated with lower odds of all included adverse pregnancy outcomes. Statistically significant associations were observed for preterm birth (<37 weeks) (adjusted odds ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.91 to 0.99), very preterm birth (28 weeks to 31 weeks) (0.85, 0.75 to 0.97), spontaneous preterm birth (0.95, 0.91 to 0.99), preterm prelabour rupture of membranes (0.93, 0.87 to 1.00), and severe small for gestational age infant (0.92, 0.87 to 0.97). Risk reduction was generally more pronounced among women vaccinated at younger ages. CONCLUSIONS: Quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy was associated with a lower risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly among women vaccinated at earlier ages, extending benefits of human papillomavirus vaccination beyond cancer prevention.

title: Conocimientos, actitudes y prácticas sobre infecciones por virus del papiloma humano en mujeres encuestadas de países latinoamericanos Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding human papillomavirus infections among women surveyed in Latin American countries
abstract: Objective: To assess women's knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding HPV. Methods: An observational, descriptive, cross-sectional design was used. The study population consisted of women from Latin American countries during 2024 and 2025. The sampling was non-probabilistic, using a snowball method. Data were collected using an online survey, which included sociodemographic data, as well as knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding the prevention and early detection of HPV infection. Results: The sample included 222 women, with a mean age of 23 ± 7 years. Most reside in Peru (35.59%) and Paraguay (26.13%). The main findings were: 86.94% recognize that HPV is a virus, 99.95% that it is sexually transmitted, 80.63% that it causes cervical cancer, 66.22% had heard of the Pap test, 34.68% had undergone the test, 81.53% knew about the HPV vaccine, and 86.49% knew that this cancer is preventable. Conclusions: The level of knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding HPV among these women is acceptable, although their education should be improved to achieve higher vaccination coverage and to promote access to cervical cancer screening tests.
authors: Eloísa Karolina Pereira Gomes de Araujo
journal: Perspectivas en Ciencias Médicas y Biológicas

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to assess women's knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding human papillomavirus (HPV) infections, focusing on prevention and early detection in Latin American countries.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study used an observational, descriptive, cross-sectional design. It included a non-probabilistic sampling method with a snowball technique. Data were collected via an online survey covering sociodemographic information and knowledge, attitudes, and practices about HPV prevention and early detection.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that 86.94% of women recognized HPV as a virus, 99.95% knew it was sexually transmitted, 80.63% were aware of its role in cervical cancer, 66.22% had heard of the Pap test, 34.68% had undergone the test, 81.53% knew about the HPV vaccine, and 86.49% understood that cervical cancer is preventable.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study acknowledges limitations in its non-probabilistic sampling method, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. Additionally, it does not provide detailed information on the effectiveness of current educational interventions or the reasons behind low vaccination coverage and screening rates.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: To improve vaccination coverage and promote access to cervical cancer screening tests, there is a need for enhanced educational programs targeting women in Latin America. Further research should focus on understanding the barriers to HPV vaccination and screening, as well as the effectiveness of different educational strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review assesses knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding human papillomavirus (HPV) among women in Latin American countries. It highlights that most women recognize HPV as a virus and understand its sexual transmission and link to cervical cancer. However, awareness of specific prevention methods, such as the Pap test and HPV vaccine, remains variable. The study suggests that improving education could enhance vaccination rates and screening access. The non-probabilistic sampling method limits the generalizability of findings, and further research is needed to address gaps in understanding the barriers to HPV prevention and early detection.

abstract_zh: 目的:评估女性关于 HPV 的知识、态度和实践。方法:采用观察性、描述性、横断面设计。研究人群由 2024 年至 2025 年拉丁美洲国家的女性组成。抽样采用滚雪球法,采用非概率方式。通过在线调查收集数据,其中包括社会人口统计数据以及有关预防和早期检测 HPV 感染的知识、态度和实践。结果:样本包括 222 名女性,平均年龄为 23 ± 7 岁。大多数居住在秘鲁(35.59%)和巴拉圭(26.13%)。主要调查结果为:86.94%的人认识到HPV是一种病毒,99.95%的人认为它是通过性传播的,80.63%的人认为它会导致宫颈癌,66.22%的人听说过巴氏试验,34.68%的人做过检查,81.53%的人知道HPV 疫苗,86.49%的人知道这种癌症是可以预防的。结论:这些女性关于 HPV 的知识、态度和实践水平是可以接受的,但应提高她们的教育水平以实现更高的 疫苗接种 覆盖率并促进获得 宫颈癌 筛查测试。

title: Knowledge, attitudes, and prevention practices regarding human papillomavirus among health and social science female students in Northwest Ethiopia: A comparative cross-sectional study
abstract: BACKGROUND: University students are vital for Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) prevention, yet comparative data between academic disciplines remain limited. This study compared HPV knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) among female health and Social Science students at Debre Tabor University. OBJECTIVE: To compare HPV knowledge, attitudes, and prevention practices (KAP) among female Health and Social Science students and identify sociodemographic predictors of these outcomes. METHODS: Design: Institutional-Based, comparative cross-sectional study. Setting: Debre Tabor University, Northwest Ethiopia, conducted from June to July 2025. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: HPV knowledge (good vs. poor), attitudes (good vs. poor), and vaccination practices (good vs. Multivariable logistic regression identified independent predictors of poor outcomes. RESULTS: Health science students (HSS) reported higher awareness (83.6% vs. 56.7%) and more positive attitudes (57.3% vs. 37.6%) than Social Science students (SSS). However, both groups exhibited poor knowledge: 61.2% of HSS and 80.9% of SSS scored <50% on knowledge questions, and critically low vaccination rates (HSS: 18.2%; SSS: 15.2%). For HSS, lack of prior awareness was the strongest predictor of poor practice (AOR = 7.61, 95% CI = 1.65-35.12). For SSS, second-year students had 3.39 times higher odds of poor practice compared to seniors (AOR = 3.39; 95% CI: 1.04-10.99). SSS predominantly relied on social media (45.0%), while HSS used academic sources (67.5%). CONCLUSION: A profound knowledge-practice gap exists regardless of the field of study. High reliance on social media among SSS and low practice among mid-level students suggest that university-based interventions could potentially contribute to national efforts, though achieving population-level targets requires multi-sectoral strategies..

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) knowledge, attitudes, and prevention practices among female health and social science students at Debre Tabor University in Northwest Ethiopia. It was a comparative cross-sectional study conducted between June and July 2025. The results showed that health science students had higher awareness and more positive attitudes toward HPV compared to social science students. Despite this, both groups demonstrated poor knowledge, with over 60% of health science students and 80% of social science students scoring below 50% on knowledge assessments. Vaccination rates were also low, at 18.2% for health science students and 15.2% for social science students. The study identified lack of prior awareness as a significant predictor of poor practices among health science students, while second-year social science students had higher odds of poor practices compared to seniors. These findings highlight the need for targeted interventions to improve HPV knowledge and practices among university students, suggesting that university-based efforts could support broader public health initiatives, though multi-sectoral strategies are necessary to achieve population-level impact.

title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚西北部健康和社会科学女学生关于 人乳头瘤病毒 的知识、态度和预防实践:一项比较横断面研究
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: University students are vital for Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) prevention, yet comparative data between academic disciplines remain limited. This study compared HPV knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) among female health and Social Science students at Debre Tabor University. OBJECTIVE: To compare HPV knowledge, attitudes, and prevention practices (KAP) among female Health and Social Science students and identify sociodemographic predictors of these outcomes. METHODS: Design: Institutional-Based, comparative cross-sectional study. Setting: Debre Tabor University, Northwest Ethiopia, conducted from June to July 2025. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: HPV knowledge (good vs. poor), attitudes (good vs. poor), and vaccination practices (good vs. Multivariable logistic regression identified independent predictors of poor outcomes. RESULTS: Health science students (HSS) reported higher awareness (83.6% vs. 56.7%) and more positive attitudes (57.3% vs. 37.6%) than Social Science students (SSS). However, both groups exhibited poor knowledge: 61.2% of HSS and 80.9% of SSS scored <50% on knowledge questions, and critically low vaccination rates (HSS: 18.2%; SSS: 15.2%). For HSS, lack of prior awareness was the strongest predictor of poor practice (AOR = 7.61, 95% CI = 1.65-35.12). For SSS, second-year students had 3.39 times higher odds of poor practice compared to seniors (AOR = 3.39; 95% CI: 1.04-10.99). SSS predominantly relied on social media (45.0%), while HSS used academic sources (67.5%). CONCLUSION: A profound knowledge-practice gap exists regardless of the field of study. High reliance on social media among SSS and low practice among mid-level students suggest that university-based interventions could potentially contribute to national efforts, though achieving population-level targets requires multi-sectoral strategies..

title: Association of HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses in cervical lymphocytes and peripheral blood with regression of high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia lesions
abstract: Abstract Background While human papillomavirus (HPV)-specific T cell responses are believed to contribute to regression of HPV-associated cervical neoplasia, their role has not been fully elucidated. We investigated HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses in the cervix and peripheral blood and their association with pathological outcomes in cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN2). Methods HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses in cervical lymphocytes (CxLs) and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were quantified using overlapping peptide (OLP) pools of E7 in 38 subjects with HPV16-positive CIN2 with defined pathological outcomes. Breadth and HLA restriction of these responses were assessed using single OLPs on in vitro-expanded PBMCs. Results HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses were detected in over 30% of CxL samples but rarely detected in PBMCs unless expanded in vitro. Higher magnitudes of E7-stimulated responses in CxLs, along with elevated non-specific background responses, were associated with pathological regression of CIN2 lesions. The E7-specific T cell responses in expanded PBMCs varied in breadth among subjects and were mediated by both CD4+ and CD8+ T cells with diverse HLA restrictions. Importantly, response breadth was significantly greater in subjects with lesion regression. Conclusions HPV-specific T cell responses are preferentially localized at the site of infection and maintained at low frequencies in peripheral blood. The magnitude of local E7-stimulated response in CxLs and the breadth of E7-specific responses in expanded PBMCs were associated with pathological regression of CIN2. These associations support a potential role for E7-specific T cell responses in the regression of HPV-related cervical neoplasia.

title_zh: 宫颈淋巴细胞和外周血中 HPV16 E7 特异性 T 细胞反应与高级别宫颈上皮内瘤变病变消退的关系
source_body_en: Abstract Background While human papillomavirus (HPV)-specific T cell responses are believed to contribute to regression of HPV-associated cervical neoplasia, their role has not been fully elucidated. We investigated HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses in the cervix and peripheral blood and their association with pathological outcomes in cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN2). Methods HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses in cervical lymphocytes (CxLs) and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were quantified using overlapping peptide (OLP) pools of E7 in 38 subjects with HPV16-positive CIN2 with defined pathological outcomes. Breadth and HLA restriction of these responses were assessed using single OLPs on in vitro-expanded PBMCs. Results HPV16 E7-specific T cell responses were detected in over 30% of CxL samples but rarely detected in PBMCs unless expanded in vitro. Higher magnitudes of E7-stimulated responses in CxLs, along with elevated non-specific background responses, were associated with pathological regression of CIN2 lesions. The E7-specific T cell responses in expanded PBMCs varied in breadth among subjects and were mediated by both CD4+ and CD8+ T cells with diverse HLA restrictions. Importantly, response breadth was significantly greater in subjects with lesion regression. Conclusions HPV-specific T cell responses are preferentially localized at the site of infection and maintained at low frequencies in peripheral blood. The magnitude of local E7-stimulated response in CxLs and the breadth of E7-specific responses in expanded PBMCs were associated with pathological regression of CIN2. These associations support a potential role for E7-specific T cell responses in the regression of HPV-related cervical neoplasia.

title: Respondent-Reported Acceptability and Tolerability of a Nurse-Assisted, Self-Collected Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Cervical Cancer Screening Model in Adults With Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities: A Preliminary Report
abstract: Background and objective Adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) are screened for cervical cancer at substantially lower rates than adults without disabilities. Communication differences, sensory sensitivities, and difficulty tolerating speculum-based examination all contribute. Deferred screening is frequently recorded as patient refusal rather than as an unmet need for adapted care. Human papillomavirus (HPV) testing on self-collected vaginal specimens is now recognized as an acceptable screening option, but published implementation strategies for this population are limited. The objective of this study was to evaluate respondent-reported acceptability, tolerability, and level of assistance required for a nurse-assisted self-collected HPV screening model in an interdisciplinary primary care clinic serving adults with IDD. Methods We conducted a prospective, single-site, minimal-risk observational study at the Program for Adults with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (PAIDD) at University of Florida Health Jacksonville. Vaginal specimens for HPV testing were collected in the clinic by the patient under nurse guidance, with hands-on assistance from a trained program nurse or a caregiver as needed. The model also included structured pre-visit planning, an animated patient education video, and caregiver engagement. A structured post-visit survey administered in REDCap assessed the level and appropriateness of assistance, patient tolerance, observable distress, acceptability, and support for future use. The survey was designed as a caregiver proxy instrument and was completed directly by the patient where able; outcomes are therefore described as respondent-reported, with proxy and direct responses distinguished explicitly. Results are reported as n (%). Recruitment is ongoing toward a planned enrollment of 30, and these are preliminary findings. Results Of 23 patients identified as eligible, 18 (78.3%) were offered the pathway. Among those offered, 14 (77.8%) completed collection, and four (22.2%) declined; zero (0%) attempted collection without completing it. Uptake was 14 of 23 (60.9%) among those identified as eligible. All 14 specimens (100%) returned negative high-risk HPV results. Complete survey data were available for 13 of the 14 completed collections. Among these 13 encounters, tolerance was rated very good in 11 (84.6%) and good in two (15.4%), with zero (0%) rated fair, poor, or very poor; no distress was observed in 12 (92.3%) and mild distress in one (7.7%), with zero (0%) moderate or severe. All 13 encounters with available assistance data (100%) required hands-on assistance, provided by the nurse in nine (69.2%) and by a caregiver in four (30.8%); zero (0%) were completed unaided or with verbal coaching alone, and zero (0%) were unable to be completed despite assistance. All 13 respondents (100%) judged the level of assistance appropriate, rated the process acceptable or very acceptable, and would support offering it again. Conclusions A nurse-assisted self-collected HPV screening model was well tolerated and highly acceptable to respondents in an academic primary care clinic for adults with IDD. Every encounter with available assistance data required hands-on assistance, indicating that nursing support is integral to the model rather than incidental. Clinic efficiency, physician time, and scalability were not measured and remain hypotheses for future evaluation. Recruitment continues.

source_records.abstract: Background and objective Adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) are screened for cervical cancer at substantially lower rates than adults without disabilities. Communication differences, sensory sensitivities, and difficulty tolerating speculum-based examination all contribute. Deferred screening is frequently recorded as patient refusal rather than as an unmet need for adapted care. Human papillomavirus (HPV) testing on self-collected vaginal specimens is now recognized as an acceptable screening option, but published implementation strategies for this population are limited. The objective of this study was to evaluate respondent-reported acceptability, tolerability, and level of assistance required for a nurse-assisted self-collected HPV screening model in an interdisciplinary primary care clinic serving adults with IDD. Methods We conducted a prospective, single-site, minimal-risk observational study at the Program for Adults with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (PAIDD) at University of Florida Health Jacksonville. Vaginal specimens for HPV testing were collected in the clinic by the patient under nurse guidance, with hands-on assistance from a trained program nurse or a caregiver as needed. The model also included structured pre-visit planning, an animated patient education video, and caregiver engagement. A structured post-visit survey administered in REDCap assessed the level and appropriateness of assistance, patient tolerance, observable distress, acceptability, and support for future use. The survey was designed as a caregiver proxy instrument and was completed directly by the patient where able; outcomes are therefore described as respondent-reported, with proxy and direct responses distinguished explicitly. Results are reported as n (%). Recruitment is ongoing toward a planned enrollment of 30, and these are preliminary findings. Results Of 23 patients identified as eligible, 18 (78.3%) were offered the pathway. Among those offered, 14 (77.8%) completed collection, and four (22.2%) declined; zero (0%) attempted collection without completing it. Uptake was 14 of 23 (60.9%) among those identified as eligible. Every encounter with available assistance data required hands-on assistance, indicating that nursing support is integral to the model rather than incidental. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the acceptability and tolerability of a nurse-assisted, self-collected human papillomavirus (HPV) cervical cancer screening model in adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). The research aimed to address the lower screening rates in this population due to communication differences, sensory sensitivities, and difficulty with speculum-based exams. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 患有智力和发育障碍 (IDD) 的成年人接受 宫颈癌 筛查的比率远低于无残疾的成年人。该研究旨在评估护士协助、自行收集的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 宫颈癌 筛查模型在该人群中的可接受性和耐受性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 佛罗里达大学健康中心杰克逊维尔分校的智力和发育障碍成人项目 (PAIDD) 进行了一项前瞻性、单中心、最低风险观察性研究。该研究包括 23 名符合条件的参与者,其中 18 人提供了筛选途径,14 人完成了收集过程。
elements_zh.methods: 用于 HPV 检测的阴道标本由患者在护士指导下在诊所采集,并根据需要由经过培训的计划护士或护理人员提供实际帮助。REDCap 进行的结构化访问后调查评估了援助的水平和适当性、患者的耐受性、可观察到的痛苦、可接受性以及对未来使用的支持。该调查被设计为护理人员代理工具,并在可能的情况下由患者直接完成。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 23 名符合资格的参与者中,有 18 名(78.3%)获得了筛选途径,14 名(77.8%)完成了收集过程。在被确定符合资格的人中,23 人中有 14 人(60.9%)接受了。所有 14 个样本均返回阴性 高危型HPV 结果。在获得可用援助数据的 13 次遭遇中,全部需要亲自动手援助,其中 9 次(69.2%)由护士提供,4 次由护理人员提供(30.8%)。所有 13 名受访者均认为援助水平适当,对流程进行了可接受或非常可接受的评价,并支持再次提供援助。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为,护士协助的自我收集 HPV 筛查模型对于 IDD 成人学术初级保健诊所的受访者具有良好的耐受性和高度可接受性。该模型解决了该人群未满足的适应性护理需求。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,护士协助的自我收集 HPV 筛查可以通过解决沟通差异、感觉敏感性和难以忍受基于窥器的检查来提高 IDD 成人的 宫颈癌 筛查率。这可以为未来的实施策略提供信息,并加强 监测 和预防工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是初步的,招募工作正在进行中,计划招募 30 名受试者。没有测量诊所效率、医生时间和可扩展性,这些仍然是未来评估的假设。由于样本量有限和研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 受访者报告的护士协助、自行收集的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 宫颈癌 成人智力和发育障碍筛查模型的可接受性和耐受性:初步报告
source_body_en: Background and objective Adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) are screened for cervical cancer at substantially lower rates than adults without disabilities. Communication differences, sensory sensitivities, and difficulty tolerating speculum-based examination all contribute. Deferred screening is frequently recorded as patient refusal rather than as an unmet need for adapted care. Human papillomavirus (HPV) testing on self-collected vaginal specimens is now recognized as an acceptable screening option, but published implementation strategies for this population are limited. The objective of this study was to evaluate respondent-reported acceptability, tolerability, and level of assistance required for a nurse-assisted self-collected HPV screening model in an interdisciplinary primary care clinic serving adults with IDD. Methods We conducted a prospective, single-site, minimal-risk observational study at the Program for Adults with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (PAIDD) at University of Florida Health Jacksonville. Vaginal specimens for HPV testing were collected in the clinic by the patient under nurse guidance, with hands-on assistance from a trained program nurse or a caregiver as needed. The model also included structured pre-visit planning, an animated patient education video, and caregiver engagement. A structured post-visit survey administered in REDCap assessed the level and appropriateness of assistance, patient tolerance, observable distress, acceptability, and support for future use. The survey was designed as a caregiver proxy instrument and was completed directly by the patient where able; outcomes are therefore described as respondent-reported, with proxy and direct responses distinguished explicitly. Results are reported as n (%). Recruitment is ongoing toward a planned enrollment of 30, and these are preliminary findings. Results Of 23 patients identified as eligible, 18 (78.3%) were offered the pathway. Among those offered, 14 (77.8%) completed collection, and four (22.2%) declined; zero (0%) attempted collection without completing it. Uptake was 14 of 23 (60.9%) among those identified as eligible. All 14 specimens (100%) returned negative high-risk HPV results. Complete survey data were available for 13 of the 14 completed collections. Among these 13 encounters, tolerance was rated very good in 11 (84.6%) and good in two (15.4%), with zero (0%) rated fair, poor, or very poor; no distress was observed in 12 (92.3%) and mild distress in one (7.7%), with zero (0%) moderate or severe. All 13 encounters with available assistance data (100%) required hands-on assistance, provided by the nurse in nine (69.2%) and by a caregiver in four (30.8%); zero (0%) were completed unaided or with verbal coaching alone, and zero (0%) were unable to be completed despite assistance. All 13 respondents (100%) judged the level of assistance appropriate, rated the process acceptable or very acceptable, and would support offering it again. Conclusions A nurse-assisted self-collected HPV screening model was well tolerated and highly acceptable to respondents in an academic primary care clinic for adults with IDD. Every encounter with available assistance data required hands-on assistance, indicating that nursing support is integral to the model rather than incidental. Clinic efficiency, physician time, and scalability were not measured and remain hypotheses for future evaluation. Recruitment continues.
abstract_zh: 背景和目标 患有智力和发育障碍 (IDD) 的成年人接受 宫颈癌 筛查的比率远低于非残疾成年人。沟通差异、感官敏感性以及难以忍受基于窥器的检查都是造成这种情况的原因。推迟筛查经常被记录为患者拒绝,而不是对适应性护理的需求未得到满足。对自行采集的阴道标本进行 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 检测现已被认为是一种可接受的筛查选择,但针对该人群发布的实施策略有限。本研究的目的是评估受访者报告的接受度、耐受性以及在为成人 IDD 患者提供服务的跨学科初级保健诊所中护士协助自行收集 HPV 筛查模型所需的帮助水平。方法 我们在佛罗里达大学健康中心杰克逊维尔分校的智力和发育障碍成人项目 (PAIDD) 中进行了一项前瞻性、单中心、最低风险的观察性研究。用于 HPV 检测的阴道标本由患者在护士指导下在诊所采集,并根据需要由经过培训的计划护士或护理人员提供实际帮助。该模型还包括结构化的就诊前规划、动画患者教育视频和护理人员参与。REDCap 进行的结构化访问后调查评估了援助的水平和适当性、患者的耐受性、可观察到的痛苦、可接受性以及对未来使用的支持。该调查被设计为护理人员代理工具,并在可能的情况下由患者直接完成;因此,结果被描述为受访者报告的,并明确区分代理和直接答复。结果报告为 n (%)。招募工作正在进行中,计划招募 30 人,这些只是初步调查结果。结果 在 23 名被确定为合格的患者中,有 18 名 (78.3%) 获得了该途径。其中,14家(77.8%)已完成催收,4家(22.2%)拒绝;零 (0%) 次尝试收集但未完成。在被确定符合资格的人中,23 人中有 14 人(60.9%)接受了。所有 14 个样本 (100%) 均返回阴性 高危型HPV 结果。14 个已完成的收集中,有 13 个提供了完整的调查数据。在这 13 次遭遇中,有 11 次(84.6%)的容忍度被评为非常好,有 2 次(15.4%)的容忍度被评为良好,零次(0%)被评为一般、较差或非常差;12 人 (92.3%) 没有观察到痛苦,1 人 (7.7%) 没有观察到痛苦,零人 (0%) 中度或严重痛苦。所有 13 次遇到可用援助数据的情况 (100%) 都需要实际援助,其中 9 次 (69.2%) 由护士提供,4 次 (30.8%) 由护理人员提供;零 (0%) 人在没有帮助或仅通过口头指导的情况下完成,零 (0%) 人在有帮助的情况下仍无法完成。所有 13 名受访者 (100%) 均认为援助水平适当,认为流程可接受或非常可接受,并支持再次提供援助。结论 护士协助的自我收集 HPV 筛查模型对于 IDD 成人学术初级保健诊所的受访者具有良好的耐受性和高度接受性。每次遇到可用的援助数据都需要实际援助,这表明护理支持是该模型的组成部分而不是偶然的。临床效率、医生时间和可扩展性没有被测量,并且仍然是未来评估的假设。招募仍在继续。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 患有智力和发育障碍 (IDD) 的成年人接受 宫颈癌 筛查的比率远低于无残疾的成年人。该研究旨在评估护士协助、自行收集的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 宫颈癌 筛查模型在该人群中的可接受性和耐受性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 佛罗里达大学健康中心杰克逊维尔分校的智力和发育障碍成人项目 (PAIDD) 进行了一项前瞻性、单中心、最低风险观察性研究。该研究包括 23 名符合条件的参与者,其中 18 人提供了筛选途径,14 人完成了收集过程。
analysis_zh.methods: 用于 HPV 检测的阴道标本由患者在护士指导下在诊所采集,并根据需要由经过培训的计划护士或护理人员提供实际帮助。REDCap 进行的结构化访问后调查评估了援助的水平和适当性、患者的耐受性、可观察到的痛苦、可接受性以及对未来使用的支持。该调查被设计为护理人员代理工具,并在可能的情况下由患者直接完成。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 23 名符合资格的参与者中,有 18 名(78.3%)获得了筛选途径,14 名(77.8%)完成了收集过程。在被确定符合资格的人中,23 人中有 14 人(60.9%)接受了。所有 14 个样本均返回阴性 高危型HPV 结果。在获得可用援助数据的 13 次遭遇中,全部需要亲自动手援助,其中 9 次(69.2%)由护士提供,4 次由护理人员提供(30.8%)。所有 13 名受访者均认为援助水平适当,对流程进行了可接受或非常可接受的评价,并支持再次提供援助。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为,护士协助的自我收集 HPV 筛查模型对于 IDD 成人学术初级保健诊所的受访者具有良好的耐受性和高度可接受性。该模型解决了该人群未满足的适应性护理需求。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,护士协助的自我收集 HPV 筛查可以通过解决沟通差异、感觉敏感性和难以忍受基于窥器的检查来提高 IDD 成人的 宫颈癌 筛查率。这可以为未来的实施策略提供信息,并加强 监测 和预防工作。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是初步的,招募工作正在进行中,计划招募 30 名受试者。没有测量诊所效率、医生时间和可扩展性,这些仍然是未来评估的假设。由于样本量有限和研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title: Differential diagnostic value of PAX1 and JAM3 methylation for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia between premenopausal and postmenopausal women: a retrospective clinical study in China.
abstract: BACKGROUND: PAX1/JAM3 methylation are promising biomarkers for high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) detection, but menopausal status may affect diagnostic accuracy. This retrospective study compared their clinical performance between premenopausal and postmenopausal women undergoing colposcopy. METHODS: 705 women undergoing colposcopy for abnormal screening results and/or clinical symptoms were stratified by menopausal status, including 192 postmenopausal and 513 premenopausal women. Subjects were further classified into ≤CIN1 and CIN2+ groups according to histopathology. Diagnostic and triage utility of PAX1/JAM3 methylation for identifying CIN2+ lesions were compared between premenopausal and postmenopausal women. RESULTS: PAX1/JAM3 methylation demonstrated superior diagnostic performance for CIN2+ detection in postmenopausal women compared with premenopausal women, either alone or in combination. Sensitivities of PAX1m and JAM3m in postmenopausal women (90.00%, 95% CI: 76.34-97.21%; 82.50%, 95% CI: 67.22-92.66%) were higher than those in premenopausal women (61.98%, 95% CI: 52.71-70.65%; 60.33%, 95% CI: 51.04-69.11%) (all p < 0.05). The combination improved sensitivity to 72.73% in premenopausal women and maintained 92.50% in postmenopausal women. Besides, PAX1/JAM3 methylation outperformed cytology and HPV16/18 testing in both groups (p < 0.001). In HPV16/18-positive or cytology triage, methylation increased positive predictive values (PPVs) for CIN2+/CIN3+ and reduced colposcopy referrals . However, CIN2+ missed rates in premenopausal women (27.54% for HPV16/18-positive triage and 23.85% for cytology triage) were higher than those in postmenopausal counterparts. CONCLUSIONS: The diagnostic performance of PAX1/JAM3 methylation for high-grade cervical lesions differs distinctly between premenopausal and postmenopausal women undergoing colposcopy. Menopausal status should be considered when applying methylation biomarkers, particularly as a valuable auxiliary tool to improve diagnostic accuracy in elderly women.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化是高级别宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN) 检测的有前途的生物标志物,但绝经状态可能会影响诊断准确性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究比较了接受阴道镜检查的绝经前和绝经后女性 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化的临床表现。根据组织病理学将受试者进一步分为≤CIN1和CIN2+组。
elements_zh.methods: 705 名因异常筛查结果和/或临床症状而接受阴道镜检查的女性按绝经状态进行分层,其中包括 192 名绝经后女性和 513 名绝经前女性。比较绝经前和绝经后女性之间 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化用于识别 CIN2+ 病变的诊断和分类效用。
elements_zh.main_results: 与绝经前女性相比,PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在绝经后女性的 CIN2+ 检测中表现出优越的诊断性能,无论是单独使用还是组合使用。绝经后女性 PAX1m 和 JAM3m 的敏感性(90.00%,95% CI:76.34-97.21%;82.50%,95% CI:67.22-92.66%)高于绝经前女性(61.98%,95% CI: 52.71-70.65%;60.33%,95% CI:51.04-69.11%)(所有 p < 0.05)。该组合将绝经前女性的敏感性提高至 72.73%,绝经后女性的敏感性维持在 92.50%。此外,两组中 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化均优于细胞学和 HPV16/18 检测(p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,绝经前和绝经后接受阴道镜检查的女性之间,PAX1/JAM3 甲基化对高级宫颈病变的诊断性能存在明显差异。这一发现强调了在应用甲基化生物标志物时需要考虑绝经状态。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PAX1/JAM3 甲基化可能是提高老年女性诊断准确性的有价值的辅助工具,特别是在宫颈上皮内瘤变检测的背景下。

title_zh: PAX1和JAM3甲基化对绝经前和绝经后妇女宫颈上皮内瘤变的鉴别诊断价值:中国回顾性临床研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: PAX1/JAM3 methylation are promising biomarkers for high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) detection, but menopausal status may affect diagnostic accuracy. This retrospective study compared their clinical performance between premenopausal and postmenopausal women undergoing colposcopy. METHODS: 705 women undergoing colposcopy for abnormal screening results and/or clinical symptoms were stratified by menopausal status, including 192 postmenopausal and 513 premenopausal women. Subjects were further classified into ≤CIN1 and CIN2+ groups according to histopathology. Diagnostic and triage utility of PAX1/JAM3 methylation for identifying CIN2+ lesions were compared between premenopausal and postmenopausal women. RESULTS: PAX1/JAM3 methylation demonstrated superior diagnostic performance for CIN2+ detection in postmenopausal women compared with premenopausal women, either alone or in combination. Sensitivities of PAX1m and JAM3m in postmenopausal women (90.00%, 95% CI: 76.34-97.21%; 82.50%, 95% CI: 67.22-92.66%) were higher than those in premenopausal women (61.98%, 95% CI: 52.71-70.65%; 60.33%, 95% CI: 51.04-69.11%) (all p < 0.05). The combination improved sensitivity to 72.73% in premenopausal women and maintained 92.50% in postmenopausal women. Besides, PAX1/JAM3 methylation outperformed cytology and HPV16/18 testing in both groups (p < 0.001). In HPV16/18-positive or cytology triage, methylation increased positive predictive values (PPVs) for CIN2+/CIN3+ and reduced colposcopy referrals . However, CIN2+ missed rates in premenopausal women (27.54% for HPV16/18-positive triage and 23.85% for cytology triage) were higher than those in postmenopausal counterparts. CONCLUSIONS: The diagnostic performance of PAX1/JAM3 methylation for high-grade cervical lesions differs distinctly between premenopausal and postmenopausal women undergoing colposcopy. Menopausal status should be considered when applying methylation biomarkers, particularly as a valuable auxiliary tool to improve diagnostic accuracy in elderly women.
abstract_zh: 背景:PAX1/JAM3 甲基化是高级别宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN) 检测的有前途的生物标志物,但绝经状态可能会影响诊断准确性。这项回顾性研究比较了接受阴道镜检查的绝经前和绝经后女性的临床表现。方法:705 名因筛查结果和/或临床症状异常而接受阴道镜检查的女性按绝经状态进行分层,其中包括 192 名绝经后女性和 513 名绝经前女性。根据组织病理学将受试者进一步分为≤CIN1和CIN2+组。比较绝经前和绝经后女性之间 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在识别 CIN2+ 病变方面的诊断和分类效用。结果:与绝经前女性相比,PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在绝经后女性 CIN2+ 检测方面表现出优异的诊断性能,无论是单独使用还是组合使用。绝经后女性 PAX1m 和 JAM3m 的敏感性(90.00%,95% CI:76.34-97.21%;82.50%,95% CI:67.22-92.66%)高于绝经前女性(61.98%,95% CI: 52.71-70.65%;60.33%,95% CI:51.04-69.11%)(所有 p < 0.05)。该组合将绝经前女性的敏感性提高至 72.73%,绝经后女性的敏感性维持在 92.50%。此外,两组中 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化均优于细胞学和 HPV16/18 检测(p < 0.001)。在 HPV16/18 阳性或细胞学分诊中,甲基化增加了 CIN2+/CIN3+ 的阳性预测值 (PPV),并减少了阴道镜检查转诊。然而,绝经前女性的 CIN2+ 漏诊率(HPV16/18 阳性分诊为 27.54%,细胞学分诊为 23.85%)高于绝经后女性。结论:绝经前和绝经后接受阴道镜检查的女性中,PAX1/JAM3 甲基化对高级别宫颈病变的诊断性能存在明显差异。应用甲基化生物标志物时应考虑更年期状况,特别是作为提高老年女性诊断准确性的宝贵辅助工具。

title: A dual-functional antiviral and anticancer peptide to target intricate host-pathogen interacting proteins of human papillomavirus associated with head and neck cancer
abstract: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma is increasingly being reported worldwide, and a major contributing factor is the incidence of human papillomavirus infections. The viral infection activates proto-oncogenes and signalling mechanisms aiding in tumorigenesis. An efficient way to block the virus-induced carcinogenesis is to identify a common medicament that can effectively inhibit the viral and host proteins. In the present study, HNSCC transcriptomic profiles and HPV genes involved in host-pathogen interactions were retrieved. The overexpressed HNSCC genes were further considered for host-pathogen and protein-protein interaction network analyses. Validated viral and host hub-genes were then docked with antiviral peptides with anticancer activities and subjected to simulation studies. Interactome analyses identified CDK1, CCNA2, CAV1, BRCA1, TERT and EGFR as host hub-genes, while E5_HPV16, E6_HPV33, E7_HPV16, 18 and 33 were screened as viral hub-genes. Functional, clinical, mutational and survival analyses filtered CDK1, CCNA2 and CAV1 as potential host therapeutic targets. Four antiviral-anticancer peptides were filtered after physico-chemical screening, which were docked with the host and viral proteins. Among them, peptide 4 (AP02569) was identified to have a high average binding affinity with an average binding energy of −1048.01 kcal/mol across all targets. The molecular dynamics simulations of peptide 4 demonstrated the overall stability among the docked complexes of all targets. It further indicated that peptide 4 had minimal fluctuation across all the docked complexes, and MM-GBSA analysis showed that peptide 4 was able to form energetically stable complexes with all target proteins. Our findings suggest that dual-functional antiviral and anticancer compounds can be potent therapeutic interventions for viral-led carcinogenesis in head and neck cancer.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the development of a dual-functional antiviral and anticancer peptide to target host-pathogen interacting proteins associated with human papillomavirus (HPV) and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). The research highlights the role of HPV in carcinogenesis and identifies potential therapeutic targets through transcriptomic and interactome analyses. The study's findings may contribute to the design of targeted therapies for HPV-related cancers, particularly HNSCC. However, the evidence is based on simulation studies and interactome analyses, which may have limited clinical validation. The research does not report specific limitations, but the results are grounded in computational methods rather than experimental data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 头颈鳞状细胞癌在世界范围内的报道越来越多,其中一个主要因素是 发病率 感染。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检索了参与 宿主-病原体相互作用的 HNSCC 转录组谱和 HPV 基因,并进一步考虑了过表达的 HNSCC 基因用于 宿主-病原体和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析。

title_zh: 双功能 抗病毒药物 和抗癌肽,靶向与头颈癌相关的 人乳头瘤病毒 的复杂 宿主 病原体相互作用蛋白
source_body_en: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma is increasingly being reported worldwide, and a major contributing factor is the incidence of human papillomavirus infections. The viral infection activates proto-oncogenes and signalling mechanisms aiding in tumorigenesis. An efficient way to block the virus-induced carcinogenesis is to identify a common medicament that can effectively inhibit the viral and host proteins. In the present study, HNSCC transcriptomic profiles and HPV genes involved in host-pathogen interactions were retrieved. The overexpressed HNSCC genes were further considered for host-pathogen and protein-protein interaction network analyses. Validated viral and host hub-genes were then docked with antiviral peptides with anticancer activities and subjected to simulation studies. Interactome analyses identified CDK1, CCNA2, CAV1, BRCA1, TERT and EGFR as host hub-genes, while E5_HPV16, E6_HPV33, E7_HPV16, 18 and 33 were screened as viral hub-genes. Functional, clinical, mutational and survival analyses filtered CDK1, CCNA2 and CAV1 as potential host therapeutic targets. Four antiviral-anticancer peptides were filtered after physico-chemical screening, which were docked with the host and viral proteins. Among them, peptide 4 (AP02569) was identified to have a high average binding affinity with an average binding energy of −1048.01 kcal/mol across all targets. The molecular dynamics simulations of peptide 4 demonstrated the overall stability among the docked complexes of all targets. It further indicated that peptide 4 had minimal fluctuation across all the docked complexes, and MM-GBSA analysis showed that peptide 4 was able to form energetically stable complexes with all target proteins. Our findings suggest that dual-functional antiviral and anticancer compounds can be potent therapeutic interventions for viral-led carcinogenesis in head and neck cancer.
abstract_zh: 头颈鳞状细胞癌在世界范围内的报道越来越多,其中一个主要因素是 发病率 感染。病毒感染激活原癌基因和信号机制,有助于肿瘤发生。阻断病毒诱发癌变的有效方法是找到一种能够有效抑制病毒和宿主蛋白的常用药物。在本研究中,检索了 HNSCC 转录组谱和参与 宿主-病原体相互作用的 HPV 基因。过表达的 HNSCC 基因被进一步考虑用于 宿主 病原体和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析。然后将经过验证的病毒和 宿主 中心基因与具有抗癌活性的 抗病毒药物 肽对接,并进行模拟研究。相互作用组分析确定 CDK1、CCNA2、CAV1、BRCA1、TERT 和 EGFR 为 宿主 中心基因,而 E5_HPV16、E6_HPV33、E7_HPV16、18 和 33 被筛选为病毒中心基因。功能、临床、突变和生存分析筛选出 CDK1、CCNA2 和 CAV1 作为潜在的 宿主 治疗靶点。经过理化筛选,筛选出4条抗病毒药物抗癌肽,与宿主和病毒蛋白对接。其中,肽 4 (AP02569) 被认为具有较高的平均结合亲和力,对所有靶标的平均结合能为 -1048.01 kcal/mol。肽4的分子动力学模拟证明了所有靶标的对接复合物之间的整体稳定性。它进一步表明肽4在所有对接复合物中具有最小的波动,并且MM-GBSA分析表明肽4能够与所有目标蛋白形成能量稳定的复合物。我们的研究结果表明,双功能 抗病毒药物 和抗癌化合物可以成为头颈癌病毒导致的致癌作用的有效治疗干预措施。

title: High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Genotypes in a Private Healthcare Cohort in El Salvador
abstract: Abstract Cervical cancer remains a significant health burden in El Salvador and Latin America. While national screening programs have traditionally focused on public health sectors using conventional cytology, there is no published literature regarding populations with access to private or high-complexity healthcare systems. Most screening data comes from vulnerable populations with limited healthcare access. However, evaluating a middle-to-high socioeconomic cohort where molecular testing is readily available allows us to observe the true viral prevalence and build a more accurate national epidemiological profile. Globally, the persistence of high-risk genotypes (HR-HPV) represents a serious challenge despite vaccination efforts. Using a retrospective consecutive sampling scheme, this is the first study in El Salvador that uses molecular techniques to evaluate the prevalence of 14 high-risk genotypes among 3,245 women undergoing routine gynecological screening (predominantly estimated between 30 and 65 years of age) over a three-year period. By moving beyond traditional screening methods, this research aims to provide a new baseline for personalized preventive medicine in El Salvador, including the identification of unique viral patterns that may vary from general information typically available in previous public health assessments.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study evaluated a middle-to-high socioeconomic cohort in El Salvador where molecular testing is readily available, allowing for the observation of true viral prevalence and the building of a more accurate national epidemiological profile.
analysis_en.methods: Using a retrospective consecutive sampling scheme, this is the first study in El Salvador that uses molecular techniques to evaluate the prevalence of 14 high-risk genotypes among 3,245 women undergoing routine gynecological screening (predominantly estimated between 30 and 65 years of age) over a three-year period.
analysis_en.main_results: The study directly observed the prevalence of 14 high-risk genotypes among the participants, providing specific data on the distribution of these genotypes in a private healthcare setting.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: This research provides a new baseline for personalized preventive medicine in El Salvador by identifying unique viral patterns that may vary from general information typically available in previous public health assessments.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more targeted surveillance and screening strategies in private healthcare systems, potentially improving early detection and prevention of HPV-associated diseases.

title_zh: 萨尔瓦多私人医疗保健 队列研究 中的高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 基因型
source_body_en: Abstract Cervical cancer remains a significant health burden in El Salvador and Latin America. While national screening programs have traditionally focused on public health sectors using conventional cytology, there is no published literature regarding populations with access to private or high-complexity healthcare systems. Most screening data comes from vulnerable populations with limited healthcare access. However, evaluating a middle-to-high socioeconomic cohort where molecular testing is readily available allows us to observe the true viral prevalence and build a more accurate national epidemiological profile. Globally, the persistence of high-risk genotypes (HR-HPV) represents a serious challenge despite vaccination efforts. Using a retrospective consecutive sampling scheme, this is the first study in El Salvador that uses molecular techniques to evaluate the prevalence of 14 high-risk genotypes among 3,245 women undergoing routine gynecological screening (predominantly estimated between 30 and 65 years of age) over a three-year period. By moving beyond traditional screening methods, this research aims to provide a new baseline for personalized preventive medicine in El Salvador, including the identification of unique viral patterns that may vary from general information typically available in previous public health assessments.

title: The Convenience-anxiety Paradox: Carcinophobia and Screening Misconceptions in Minimally Supported Human Papillomavirus Self-sampling
abstract: Abstract Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling often involves a “minimally supported pathway,” wherein women receive results through impersonal channels without prescreening counseling. This “convenience–anxiety paradox” may cause psychological distress due to a communication vacuum between the healthcare system and the patient. This study assessed the prevalence and predictors of anxiety among women who received high-risk HPV results through vaginal self-sampling. Methods Seventy-two women, comprising medical professionals and university staff, were included. Anxiety was evaluated using the Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Scale-21. Demographic data, coping action, and knowledge regarding HPV were collected via questionnaire. Distress related to cervical dysplasia was assessed using the Cervical Dysplasia Distress Questionnaire. Factors predicting anxiety were determined using multivariate logistic regression. Results Anxiety prevalence was 23.6% ( n = 17). In multivariate analysis, the health consequences subscale was a potential predictor (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 1.60; p = 0.099). Furthermore, a statistically non-significant trend indicated that participants failing to distinguish “screening” (risk) from “diagnosis” (disease) of the test had an elevated point estimate for anxiety (aOR = 4.37; CI = 0.94–20.36; p = 0.060). Interestingly, working in medical practice did not mitigate anxiety ( p = 0.412), indicating that in this sample, possessing professional health knowledge did not act as a protective factor against anxiety. Conclusions Anxiety in HPV self-sampling may be associated with confusion regarding screening’s purpose. Because medical professionals experienced similar anxiety levels as non-medical staff, professional health knowledge may not fully buffer against the “information vacuum.” These results suggest a potential systemic communication gap; to scale self-sampling ethically, notification protocols should transition from simple result delivery to health-literacy-sensitive interventions that clarify the fundamental purpose of screening.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 自我采样通常涉及“最低限度支持的途径”,其中女性通过非个人渠道获得结果,无需预筛查咨询。由于医疗保健系统和患者之间的沟通真空,这种“便利-焦虑悖论”可能会导致心理困扰。本研究评估了通过阴道自我取样获得 高危型HPV 结果的女性的 患病率 和焦虑预测因子。方法 纳入了 72 名女性,其中包括医疗专业人员和大学工作人员。使用抑郁、焦虑和压力量表 21 评估焦虑程度。通过问卷收集人口统计数据、应对措施和有关 HPV 的知识。使用宫颈发育不良应激问卷评估与宫颈发育不良相关的应激。使用多元逻辑回归确定预测焦虑的因素。结果焦虑 患病率 为 23.6% ( n = 17)。在多变量分析中,健康后果子量表是一个潜在的预测因子(调整后的比值比 [aOR] = 1.60;p = 0.099)。此外,统计上不显着的趋势表明,未能区分测试的“筛查”(风险)和“诊断”(疾病)的参与者的焦虑点估计值较高(aOR = 4.37;CI = 0.94–20.36;p = 0.060)。有趣的是,从事医疗实践并不能减轻焦虑(p = 0.412),这表明在该样本中,拥有专业健康知识并不能作为对抗焦虑的保护因素。结论 HPV 自我采样的焦虑可能与筛查目的的混乱有关。由于医疗专业人员与非医务人员经历相似的焦虑水平,专业健康知识可能无法完全缓冲“信息真空”。这些结果表明存在潜在的系统性沟通差距;为了在道德上扩大自我采样的规模,通知协议应从简单的结果交付转变为健康素养敏感的干预措施,以澄清筛查的基本目的。

title: Prevalence and associated risk factors of anal high-risk human papillomavirus infection in unvaccinated young men who have sex with men visiting the Center of Sexual Health of Amsterdam
abstract: Background: Anal high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) is highly prevalent among men who have sex with men (MSM) and the main cause of anal cancer. The effectiveness of HPV vaccination in this population is highly dependent on prior HPV exposure. We aimed to assess the prevalence and determinants of anal hrHPV among young unvaccinated MSM attending the Center for Sexual Health (CSH) of Amsterdam. These findings will serve as a basis for analyses regarding the prophylactic effectiveness and population impact of HPV vaccination among MSM in the Netherlands. Methods: All unvaccinated MSM aged 19–28 years visiting the CSH of Amsterdam during the National 2023-2024 HPV catch-up campaign were eligible. Participants provided socio-demographic and sexual behaviour information, a venous blood sample and anal self-sample. Samples were tested for HPV, HIV, chlamydia, gonorrhoea, and syphilis. HPV DNA-positive anal samples were genotyped using the SPF10 DEIA/LiPA-25 system. Determinants of hrHPV positivity and HPV16/18 were examined using multivariable logistic regression with generalized estimating equations. Results: Among 431 MSM (median age 24 years), 51.0% tested positive for any anal hrHPV-type, 14.6% for HPV16 and 8.1% for HPV18. In multivariable analyses, lifetime number of sexual partners (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] per natural log increase: 1.33, 95%CI 1.16–1.51), inconsistent versus consistent condom use during receptive anal intercourse (aOR 1.68, 95%CI 1.02–2.76) and anal gonorrhoea (aOR 1.51, 95%CI 1.00-2.29) were associated with hrHPV positivity. Conclusions: Prevalence of hrHPV among young unvaccinated MSM is high and associated with sexual behaviours and inconsistent condom use.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估在阿姆斯特丹性健康中心 (CSH) 就读的未接种疫苗的男男性行为者 (MSM) 的 患病率 和肛门高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (hrHPV) 的决定因素。这很重要,因为 HPV 疫苗接种 在该人群中的有效性高度依赖于之前的 HPV 暴露。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究纳入了 2023-2024 年全国 HPV 补种运动期间访问阿姆斯特丹 CSH 的 431 名 19-28 岁未接种疫苗的 MSM。参与者提供了社会人口统计和性行为信息、静脉血样本和肛门自我样本。
elements_zh.methods: 对样本进行了 HPV、HIV、衣原体、淋病和梅毒检测。使用 SPF10 DEIA/LiPA-25 系统对 HPV DNA 阳性肛门样本进行基因分型。使用多变量逻辑回归和广义估计方程检查 hrHPV 阳性和 HPV16/18 的决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 431 名 MSM 中,51.0% 的任何肛门 hrHPV 型检测呈阳性,14.6% 的 HPV16 检测呈阳性,8.1% 的 HPV18 检测呈阳性。在多变量分析中,终生性伴侣数量、接受性肛交期间安全套使用不一致以及肛门淋病与 hrHPV 阳性相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,年轻未接种疫苗的 MSM 中 hrHPV 的 患病率 较高,与性行为和不一致的安全套使用有关。这些发现将作为分析 HPV 疫苗接种 在荷兰 MSM 中的预防效果和人群影响的基础。

This is important because the effectiveness of HPV vaccination in this population is highly dependent on prior HPV exposure.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study included 431 unvaccinated MSM aged 19–28 years visiting the CSH of Amsterdam during the National 2023-2024 HPV catch-up campaign. Participants provided socio-demographic and sexual behavior information, a venous blood sample, and an anal self-sample.
analysis_en.methods: Samples were tested for HPV, HIV, chlamydia, gonorrhoea, and syphilis. HPV DNA-positive anal samples were genotyped using the SPF10 DEIA/LiPA-25 system. Determinants of hrHPV positivity and HPV16/18 were examined using multivariable logistic regression with generalized estimating equations.
analysis_en.main_results: Among 431 MSM, 51.0% tested positive for any anal hrHPV-type, 14.6% for HPV16, and 8.1% for HPV18. In multivariable analyses, lifetime number of sexual partners, inconsistent condom use during receptive anal intercourse, and anal gonorrhoea were associated with hrHPV positivity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found a high prevalence of hrHPV among young unvaccinated MSM, with associations with sexual behaviors and inconsistent condom use. analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of hrHPV among young MSM, and highlight the importance of sexual health education and consistent condom use to reduce hrHPV infection and associated risks.

title_zh: 患病率 和访问阿姆斯特丹性健康中心的男男性行为未接种疫苗的年轻男性肛门高危 人乳头瘤病毒 感染的相关危险因素
source_body_en: Background: Anal high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) is highly prevalent among men who have sex with men (MSM) and the main cause of anal cancer. The effectiveness of HPV vaccination in this population is highly dependent on prior HPV exposure. We aimed to assess the prevalence and determinants of anal hrHPV among young unvaccinated MSM attending the Center for Sexual Health (CSH) of Amsterdam. These findings will serve as a basis for analyses regarding the prophylactic effectiveness and population impact of HPV vaccination among MSM in the Netherlands. Methods: All unvaccinated MSM aged 19–28 years visiting the CSH of Amsterdam during the National 2023-2024 HPV catch-up campaign were eligible. HPV DNA-positive anal samples were genotyped using the SPF10 DEIA/LiPA-25 system. Determinants of hrHPV positivity and HPV16/18 were examined using multivariable logistic regression with generalized estimating equations. Results: Among 431 MSM (median age 24 years), 51.0% tested positive for any anal hrHPV-type, 14.6% for HPV16 and 8.1% for HPV18. title: Prevalence and factors associated with high-risk human papillomavirus among women living with HIV attending a rural hospital in Uganda: a 2024 cross-sectional survey
abstract: Abstract Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) is now known to be the main factor in the aetiology of cervical cancer, particularly among HIV-positive women(WLHIV). Despite this risk, the factors associated with high risk HPV(hrHPV) infection in this population are poorly understood. We explored these factors to inform the design of effective, targeted screening and intervention strategies that are tailored to the unique risks faced by WLHIV. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study among reproductive age WLHIV receiving care at Kagadi Hospital, Western Uganda. We recruited participants by systematic random sampling and collected data using a pretested, standardized questionnaire. Cervical specimens were obtained from the participants and tested for hrHPV, using the Cepheid Xpert HPV test on a GeneXpert machine. Descriptive statistics and modified Poisson regression analysis were performed using STATA 17. Results A total of 213 WLHIV consented to participate in the study, with 85 (39.9%) testing positive for hrHPV. Among those who were hrHPV positive, 11.8% had HPV type 16, 11.8% had HPV type 18/45, 3.5% had both HPV 16 and 18/45, 3.5% had HPV 18/45 and other types and 7.1% had all the tested strains. Key factors significantly associated with increased hrHPV infection risk included being married (aPR = 1.6, 95% CI: 1.1–2.5, p < 0.01), using hormonal contraceptives (aPR = 1.5, 95% CI: 1.1–2.2, p < 0.01), alcohol consumption (aPR = 1.4, 95% CI: 1.1–2.1, p < 0.05), and having a detectable viral load (aPR = 1.7, 95% CI: 1.1–2.5, p < 0.05). Conclusions The prevalence of hrHPV infection, among WLHIV in rural Western Uganda, was concerningly high at nearly 40%. Intervention strategies for risk mitigation may need to emphasize reduction in alcohol consumption, viral load suppression through adherence to antiretroviral therapy, and expert guided hormonal contraceptive use. Risk associated with marital status may require further investigation.

We explored these factors to inform the design of effective, targeted screening and intervention strategies that are tailored to the unique risks faced by WLHIV. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study among reproductive age WLHIV receiving care at Kagadi Hospital, Western Uganda. We recruited participants by systematic random sampling and collected data using a pretested, standardized questionnaire. Cervical specimens were obtained from the participants and tested for hrHPV, using the Cepheid Xpert HPV test on a GeneXpert machine. Descriptive statistics and modified Poisson regression analysis were performed using STATA 17. Results A total of 213 WLHIV consented to participate in the study, with 85 (39.9%) testing positive for hrHPV. Among those who were hrHPV positive, 11.8% had HPV type 16, 11.8% had HPV type 18/45, 3.5% had both HPV 16 and 18/45, 3.5% had HPV 18/45 and other types and 7.1% had all the tested strains. Key factors significantly associated with increased hrHPV infection risk included being married (aPR = 1.6, 95% CI: 1.1–2.5, p < 0.01), using hormonal contraceptives (aPR = 1.5, 95% CI: 1.1–2.2, p < 0.01), alcohol consumption (aPR = 1.4, 95% CI: 1.1–2.1, p < 0.05), and having a detectable viral load (aPR = 1.7, 95% CI: 1.1–2.5, p < 0.05). Conclusions The prevalence of hrHPV infection, among WLHIV in rural Western Uganda, was concerningly high at nearly 40%. Intervention strategies for risk mitigation may need to emphasize reduction in alcohol consumption, viral load suppression through adherence to antiretroviral therapy, and expert guided hormonal contraceptive use. Risk associated with marital status may require further investigation.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study aimed to investigate the prevalence and factors associated with high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infection among women living with HIV (WLHIV) in rural Western Uganda, with the goal of informing targeted screening and intervention strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among reproductive age WLHIV receiving care at Kagadi Hospital, Western Uganda. Participants were recruited using systematic random sampling, and data were collected via a pretested, standardized questionnaire. Cervical specimens were tested for hrHPV using the Cepheid Xpert HPV test on a GeneXpert machine. Descriptive statistics and modified Poisson regression analysis were performed using STATA 17.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The prevalence of hrHPV infection among WLHIV in rural Western Uganda was found to be 39.9%, with specific HPV types (16, 18/45) identified. Key factors significantly associated with increased hrHPV infection risk included marital status, hormonal contraceptive use, alcohol consumption, and detectable viral load.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study did not provide detailed information on the biological mechanisms linking these risk factors to hrHPV infection. Additionally, the risk associated with marital status requires further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Intervention strategies for risk mitigation should emphasize reduction in alcohol consumption, viral load suppression through adherence to antiretroviral therapy, and expert-guided hormonal contraceptive use.

analysis.summary_en: This 2024 cross-sectional survey conducted at Kagadi Hospital in rural Western Uganda aimed to assess the prevalence and risk factors for high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infection among women living with HIV (WLHIV). The study found that 39.9% of participants tested positive for hrHPV, with HPV types 16 and 18/45 being most common. Factors significantly associated with increased hrHPV infection risk included being married, using hormonal contraceptives, alcohol consumption, and having a detectable viral load. The findings highlight the need for targeted interventions to reduce alcohol use, suppress viral load through antiretroviral therapy, and ensure proper guidance on hormonal contraceptive use. The study also notes that the risk associated with marital status requires further investigation. These results can inform the development of more effective screening and prevention strategies for WLHIV in similar settings.

title: Effect of a comic book-based educational intervention on human papillomavirus vaccine knowledge and safety perception among girls aged 9–14 in Nigeria
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of death for women and is preventable with the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine and regular screening. However, awareness of vaccines and screenings is poor in many low- and middle-income countries. In 2023, Nigeria sought to deliver 15 million doses of the HPV vaccine to girls aged 9-14. Within this vaccination campaign, we studied the effect of a comic book educational intervention on knowledge and perception of HPV, cervical cancer, and vaccine safety in girls eligible for the vaccine. METHODS: This single-arm study evaluated the effect of a bundled educational intervention on HPV knowledge and safety perception. The three-part intervention was a schoolwide assembly and lecture for children using a culturally tailored comic book as a guide, distribution of the comic book to all the children at the school and then separate focus groups with adult community leaders. The primary outcome was the change in the HPV knowledge score in girls aged 9-14 six weeks post-intervention. Exploratory outcomes were the differential effect of low versus high baseline knowledge, vaccine safety perception, and change in vaccine receipt status at the class level. RESULTS: We found significant gains in knowledge across all four states (n = 396; p < 0.01). Classes with lower baseline knowledge gained more from the intervention (p < 0.01). Perception of vaccine safety increased from 62% to 81% (p < 0.01). We did not find a relationship between increased learning and vaccination receipt (p = 0.16). CONCLUSION: Awareness and positive perception of the safety of the HPV vaccine increased following an educational comic book intervention in girls aged 9-14 across Nigeria. Comics may be a low-cost, scalable, and culturally adaptable tool for health education.

title: Micronucleus cytome assay reveals genomic instability in premalignant cervical lesions among high-risk HPV-positive women
abstract: Cervical cancer is a major health burden driven by persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV). Genomic instability biomarkers from the micronucleus cytome (MNcyt) assay may improve identification of women at risk of progression beyond cytology and HPV testing. A cross-sectional study of 184 women attending routine cervical cancer screening was conducted in Popayán, Colombia. Exfoliated cervical epithelial cells were collected for HPV DNA genotyping, liquid-based cytology, and MNcyt analysis using the Feulgen-Fast Green DNA-specific method. For each sample, 2,000 cells were scored for micronuclei, nuclear buds, binucleated cells, pyknotic cells, karyorrhectic cells, karyolytic cells, and cells with condensed chromatin. Group differences and trends were assessed across ordered HPV/cytology categories; genotype analyses used age-adjusted models and, among HPV-positive women, models adjusted for age and cytology. Women were classified as HPV-negative with negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (HPV-/NILM, n = 69), HPV-positive with NILM (HPV+/NILM, n = 47), HPV-positive with atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance or low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HPV+/ASCUS-LSIL, n = 49), and HPV-positive with high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion or worse (HPV+/≥HSIL, n = 19). Significant positive trends across these ordered categories were observed for micronuclei (p = 0.044), nuclear buds (p = 0.029), and binucleated cells (p = 0.011). Among HPV-positive women, genotype differences adjusted for age and cytology were observed for nuclear buds (p = 0.046), karyolytic cells (p = 0.010), and condensed chromatin (p = 0.035). Overall, micronuclei, nuclear buds, and binucleated cells showed consistent patterns of genomic instability across HPV/cytology categories, while genotype-focused analyses also identified differences in selected genotoxic and cytotoxic endpoints. These findings support the potential value of MNcyt biomarkers as a complementary approach for risk assessment in HPV-related cervical disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated genomic instability in cervical lesions among high-risk HPV-positive women using the micronucleus cytome (MNcyt) assay. The research aimed to improve risk assessment beyond traditional cytology and HPV testing. A cross-sectional design was employed, involving 184 women in Popayán, Colombia, classified based on HPV status and cervical cytology results. The MNcyt assay was used to evaluate biomarkers of genomic instability, including micronuclei, nuclear buds, and binucleated cells. Significant positive trends were observed across ordered HPV/cytology categories for micronuclei, nuclear buds, and binucleated cells. Genotype-focused analyses also revealed differences in selected genotoxic and cytotoxic endpoints among HPV-positive women. These findings suggest that MNcyt biomarkers could serve as a valuable tool for assessing risk in HPV-related cervical disease. The study provides insights into the utility of the MNcyt assay for identifying women at risk of progression, but it does not address limitations or evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 宫颈癌 是高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 持续感染造成的主要健康负担。微核细胞组 (MNcyt) 检测中的基因组不稳定性生物标志物可以改善对细胞学和 HPV 检测之外的进展风险女性的识别。在哥伦比亚波帕扬对 184 名参加常规 宫颈癌 筛查的女性进行了一项横断面研究。收集脱落的宫颈上皮细胞,使用 Feulgen-Fast Green DNA 特异性方法进行 HPV DNA 基因分型、液基细胞学和 MNcyt 分析。对于每个样品,对 2,000 个细胞的微核、核芽、双核细胞、固缩细胞、核分裂细胞、核溶解细胞和具有浓缩染色质的细胞进行评分。跨有序 HPV/细胞学类别评估组间差异和趋势;基因型分析使用年龄调整模型,并且在 HPV 阳性女性中,使用年龄和细胞学调整模型。女性被分类为 HPV 阴性,上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤阴性(HPV-/NILM,n = 69),HPV 阳性 NILM(HPV+/NILM,n = 47),HPV 阳性,伴有意义不明的非典型鳞状细胞或低度鳞状上皮内病变(HPV+/ASCUS-LSIL,n = 49),以及 HPV 阳性,伴有高级鳞状上皮内病变病变或更严重(HPV+/≥HSIL,n = 19)。在这些有序类别中,观察到微核 (p = 0.044)、核芽 (p = 0.029) 和双核细胞 (p = 0.011) 的显着正趋势。在 HPV 阳性女性中,根据年龄和细胞学调整后,观察到核芽 (p = 0.046)、核溶解细胞 (p = 0.010) 和浓缩染色质 (p = 0.035) 的基因型差异。总体而言,微核、核芽和双核细胞在 HPV/细胞学类别中表现出一致的基因组不稳定性模式,而以基因型为重点的分析也发现了选定的基因毒性和细胞毒性终点的差异。这些发现支持 MNcyt 生物标志物作为 HPV 相关宫颈疾病风险评估的补充方法的潜在价值。

title: Ecological and inferred functional landscape of the cervicovaginal microbiome in relation to HPV infection and disease in Kenyan women
abstract: Abstract Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the central cause of cervical cancer, but the association of the microbiome with disease severity from normal cytology to cervical lesions remains incompletely understood, particularly in African populations. Here, we characterized the cervicovaginal microbiome of 91 Kenyan women with negative cytology, low-grade, or high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions using 16S rRNA gene sequencing, HPV genotyping, and Trichomonas vaginalis detection. Cervicovaginal communities resolved into six distinct ecological states or cervicotypes that differed in dominant taxa and composition. Increasing lesion severity was associated with depletion of Lactobacillus communities and shifts in specific bacterial taxa. Microbial co-occurrence analysis further identified Lactobacillus -, Gardnerella -, and Delftia -associated ecological modules, with the Lactobacillus -associated module inversely related to cytological severity and HPV infection. Inferred functional profiling identified 35 pathways significantly associated with increasing lesion severity, including changes in carbohydrate, amino acid, fatty acid, aromatic compound, nucleotide, and cofactor metabolism. These inferred functional signatures correlated with the Delftia -associated module. Exploratory penalized regression analyses showed that ecological features provided modest discriminatory information in addition to clinical variables. Altogether, these findings identify coordinated ecological and inferred functional changes in the cervicovaginal microbiome associated with cervical disease severity and support further investigation of microbial ecological organization in HPV-associated cervical disease.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the central cause of cervical cancer, but the association of the microbiome with disease severity from normal cytology to cervical lesions remains incompletely understood, particularly in African populations. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解肯尼亚女性的宫颈阴道微生物群与宫颈疾病严重程度之间的关系,特别是与 HPV 感染相关的关系,从而解决非洲人群中微生物群与 宫颈癌 之间尚未完全了解的联系。

elements_zh.main_results: 病变严重程度的增加与乳酸菌群落的消耗和特定细菌类群的变化有关。微生物共现分析进一步鉴定了乳杆菌、加德纳菌和代尔夫特菌相关的生态模块,其中乳杆菌相关的模块与细胞学严重程度和 HPV 感染呈负相关。功能分析确定了 35 条与病变严重程度增加显着相关的途径,包括与 Delftia 相关模块相关的碳水化合物、氨基酸、脂肪酸、芳香化合物、核苷酸和辅因子代谢的变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,宫颈阴道微生物组的生态和推断功能变化与宫颈疾病严重程度相关,并支持进一步研究 HPV 相关宫颈疾病的微生物生态组织。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过识别潜在的生物标志物和功能途径,为 监测、诊断 和 治疗 提供有关 HPV 相关宫颈疾病的信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 除了临床变量之外,该研究的生态特征还提供了适度的歧视性信息,样本量和特定的肯尼亚人群可能会限制普遍性。

abstract_zh: 摘要 持续高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染是 宫颈癌 的主要原因,但微生物组与从正常细胞学到宫颈病变的疾病严重程度之间的关系仍不完全清楚,特别是在非洲人群中。在这里,我们使用 16S rRNA 基因测序、HPV 基因分型和阴道毛滴虫检测对 91 名细胞学阴性、低度或重度鳞状上皮内病变的肯尼亚女性的宫颈阴道微生物组进行了表征。宫颈阴道群落分为六种不同的生态状态或宫颈类型,其主要分类群和组成不同。病变严重程度的增加与乳酸菌群落的消耗和特定细菌类群的变化有关。微生物共现分析进一步鉴定了乳杆菌、加德纳菌和代尔夫特菌相关的生态模块,其中乳杆菌相关的模块与细胞学严重程度和HPV感染呈负相关。推断的功能分析确定了 35 条与病变严重程度增加显着相关的途径,包括碳水化合物、氨基酸、脂肪酸、芳香族化合物、核苷酸和辅因子代谢的变化。这些推断的功能特征与 Delftia 相关模块相关。探索性惩罚回归分析表明,除了临床变量之外,生态特征还提供了适度的歧视性信息。总而言之,这些发现确定了与宫颈疾病严重程度相关的宫颈阴道微生物组的协调生态和推断功能变化,并支持进一步研究 HPV 相关宫颈疾病的微生物生态组织。

title: Long-term immunogenicity and efficacy of the quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccine in women with HIV: a longitudinal cohort study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Understanding the impact of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in women with HIV, who have higher rates of HPV infection and associated disease, is vital to achieving cervical cancer elimination. We aimed to assess the immunogenicity and efficacy of the quadrivalent HPV (qHPV) vaccine up to 9 years in a cohort of women with HIV. METHODS: This longitudinal multicentre cohort study recruited girls and women with HIV aged 9 years and older from 14 clinics providing HIV and gynaecological care across Canada. Participants were administered three doses of qHPV vaccine at 0, 2, and 6 months and followed up from July 1, 2008, to June 27, 2019. Clinical data, anti-HPV serology, liquid-based cervical cytology, and HPV DNA genotyping were conducted at baseline and every 6-12 months. Immunogenicity endpoints were anti-HPV geometric mean titres (GMTs) and seropositivity rates. We assessed the effect of time-varying HIV parameters on time to seroreversion with extended Cox regression models. GMTs for an age-restricted subset (24-45 years) were compared with a published cohort with one-sample t tests. Efficacy endpoints were the incidence of persistent qHPV, genital warts, and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia of grade two and higher (CIN2+). FINDINGS: There were 228 participants in the per-protocol population, with a median age at baseline of 38·5 years (IQR 32·0-45·4), median CD4 count of 499·5 (IQR 380·8-700·0) cells per μL, and 160 (70·2%) participants had suppressed HIV viral loads (<50 copies per mL). Median follow-up was 5·9 years (IQR 2·3-7·7). In the per-protocol population, following very high seroconversion rates at month 7, during follow-up there were 18 (13·6%) of 132 seroreversions for HPV6, 22 (11·8%) of 186 for HPV11, 12 (8·5%) of 141 for HPV16, and 60 (36·4%) of 165 for HPV18. Peak antibody titres and serial HIV viral load were significant predictors of time to seroreversion. Anti-HPV GMTs were similar between women with and without HIV (historical comparator group) for up to 9 years. In the per-protocol population, the incidence of persistent qHPV was 0·52 (95% CI 0·22-1·10) per 100 person-years, the incidence of genital warts was 0·37 (0·12-0·87) per 100 person-years, and the incidence of CIN2+ was 0·00 (0·00-0·24) per 100 person-years. INTERPRETATION: These data show low rates of infection and disease in this vaccinated cohort of women with HIV. Continual HIV viral load suppression after vaccination is important to ensure continued protection. FUNDING: Canadian Institutes for Health Research (CIHR), CIHR Canadian HIV Trials Network, and in-kind contribution from Merck Canada.
authors: CTN 236 HPV in HIV Study Team

analysis.summary_en: This longitudinal cohort study evaluated the immunogenicity and efficacy of the quadrivalent human papillomavirus (qHPV) vaccine in women with HIV over a 9-year period. The study recruited participants from 14 clinics across Canada and followed them from 2008 to 2019. Immunogenicity was measured through geometric mean titres (GMTs) and seropositivity rates, while efficacy was assessed by tracking the incidence of persistent qHPV, genital warts, and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2+). The results showed that seroreversion rates varied among HPV types, with HPV18 having the highest rate. Peak antibody titres and HIV viral load were significant predictors of seroreversion. Anti-HPV GMTs were similar between women with and without HIV. The study highlights the importance of HIV viral load suppression for maintaining vaccine protection. However, the evidence is moderate due to the observational design and reliance on a historical comparator group.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 了解 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 对 HIV 感染女性(HPV 感染及相关疾病发生率较高)的影响对于实现 宫颈癌 消除至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项纵向多中心 队列研究 研究从加拿大各地提供艾滋病毒和妇科护理的 14 家诊所招募了 9 岁及以上感染艾滋病毒的女孩和妇女。参与者在0、2和6个月时接受了三剂qHPV 疫苗,并于2008年7月1日至2019年6月27日进行随访。
elements_zh.methods: 在基线和每 6-12 个月进行一次临床数据、抗 HPV 血清学、液基宫颈细胞学检查和 HPV DNA 基因分型。免疫原性终点是抗 HPV 几何平均滴度 (GMT) 和血清阳性率。该研究利用扩展的 Cox 回归模型评估了随时间变化的 HIV 参数对血清逆转时间的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在符合方案的人群中,第 7 个月的血清转换率非常高,在随访期间,132 例 HPV6 血清中有 18 例 (13·6%),186 例 HPV11 中有 22 例 (11·8%),141 例 HPV16 中有 12 例 (8·5%),165 例 HPV18 中有 60 例 (36·4%)。峰值抗体滴度和连续 HIV 病毒载量是血清逆转时间的重要预测因素。在长达 9 年的时间里,感染和未感染 HIV 的女性(历史比较组)的抗 HPV GMT 相似。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些数据显示,接种 队列研究 的 HIV 女性感染率和患病率较低。该研究为四价 HPV 疫苗 对长期感染 HIV 的女性的免疫原性和功效提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 疫苗接种 后持续抑制 HIV 病毒载量对于确保持续保护非常重要。这些发现对于感染艾滋病毒的女性中 HPV 相关疾病的管理具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其对历史比较组的依赖以及与艾滋病毒管理相关的混杂因素的可能性。由于研究的观察性质和比较组的使用,证据的强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 了解 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 对 HIV 感染女性(HPV 感染及相关疾病发生率较高)的影响对于实现 宫颈癌 消除至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项纵向多中心 队列研究 研究从加拿大各地提供艾滋病毒和妇科护理的 14 家诊所招募了 9 岁及以上感染艾滋病毒的女孩和妇女。参与者在0、2和6个月时接受了三剂qHPV 疫苗,并于2008年7月1日至2019年6月27日进行随访。
analysis_zh.methods: 在基线和每 6-12 个月进行一次临床数据、抗 HPV 血清学、液基宫颈细胞学检查和 HPV DNA 基因分型。免疫原性终点是抗 HPV 几何平均滴度 (GMT) 和血清阳性率。该研究利用扩展的 Cox 回归模型评估了随时间变化的 HIV 参数对血清逆转时间的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在符合方案的人群中,第 7 个月的血清转换率非常高,在随访期间,132 例 HPV6 血清中有 18 例 (13·6%),186 例 HPV11 中有 22 例 (11·8%),141 例 HPV16 中有 12 例 (8·5%),165 例 HPV18 中有 60 例 (36·4%)。峰值抗体滴度和连续 HIV 病毒载量是血清逆转时间的重要预测因素。在长达 9 年的时间里,感染和未感染 HIV 的女性(历史比较组)的抗 HPV GMT 相似。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些数据显示,接种 队列研究 的 HIV 女性感染率和患病率较低。该研究为四价 HPV 疫苗 对长期感染 HIV 的女性的免疫原性和功效提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 疫苗接种 后持续抑制 HIV 病毒载量对于确保持续保护非常重要。这些发现对于感染艾滋病毒的女性中 HPV 相关疾病的管理具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其对历史比较组的依赖以及与艾滋病毒管理相关的混杂因素的可能性。由于研究的观察性质和比较组的使用,证据的强度中等。
