title: Awareness of cervical cancer, human papillomavirus vaccination, and cervical cancer screening among syrian women: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Cervical cancer, despite being highly preventable, remains a major public health concern, particularly in low-resource settings such as Syria. Due to limited national data, we aimed to evaluate the awareness of Syrian women regarding cervical cancer and its prevention strategies, as well as their practice of these methods. A cross-sectional study was conducted among Syrian women aged 16 years or older residing in Damascus and Rif Dimashq, using an anonymous, self-administered questionnaire adapted from the CCKP-64 instrument and distributed online from 1 December 2025 to 1 March 2026 via social media platforms using a snowball sampling technique. Data analysis was performed with IBM SPSS Statistics v25. Data were collected from 405 Syrian women. A knowledge-to-action gap was observed. Despite most participants recognizing that cervical cancer can be linked to an infection (86.2%) and moderate familiarity with Pap smear (59.8%), actual screening rates were low, with only 6.9% ever screened. HPV vaccine awareness was limited (35.1%), with an even smaller proportion vaccinated (3%), and only 11.6% correctly identified the optimal age range for vaccination as 9 to 13 years. Notably, only a small proportion of participants (9.1%) had direct contact with affected individuals, and 31.9% thought the disease could affect them in the future. Knowledge of risk factors was moderate (mean score: 49.16 ± 8.14 out of 85), yet misconceptions persisted regarding non-established risk factors. The multivariate analysis showed that parental healthcare employment and age groups older than 16–19 years independently predicted higher knowledge of risk factors ( p < 0.05). High cervical cancer awareness among Syrian women did not translate into preventive action, confirming that knowledge alone is insufficient; therefore, integrating HPV vaccination into the national immunisation program alongside targeted educational efforts is crucially needed.

title_zh: 叙利亚女性对 宫颈癌、人乳头瘤病毒、疫苗接种 和 宫颈癌 筛查的认识:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Cervical cancer, despite being highly preventable, remains a major public health concern, particularly in low-resource settings such as Syria. Due to limited national data, we aimed to evaluate the awareness of Syrian women regarding cervical cancer and its prevention strategies, as well as their practice of these methods. A cross-sectional study was conducted among Syrian women aged 16 years or older residing in Damascus and Rif Dimashq, using an anonymous, self-administered questionnaire adapted from the CCKP-64 instrument and distributed online from 1 December 2025 to 1 March 2026 via social media platforms using a snowball sampling technique. Data analysis was performed with IBM SPSS Statistics v25. Data were collected from 405 Syrian women. A knowledge-to-action gap was observed. Despite most participants recognizing that cervical cancer can be linked to an infection (86.2%) and moderate familiarity with Pap smear (59.8%), actual screening rates were low, with only 6.9% ever screened. HPV vaccine awareness was limited (35.1%), with an even smaller proportion vaccinated (3%), and only 11.6% correctly identified the optimal age range for vaccination as 9 to 13 years. Notably, only a small proportion of participants (9.1%) had direct contact with affected individuals, and 31.9% thought the disease could affect them in the future. Knowledge of risk factors was moderate (mean score: 49.16 ± 8.14 out of 85), yet misconceptions persisted regarding non-established risk factors. The multivariate analysis showed that parental healthcare employment and age groups older than 16–19 years independently predicted higher knowledge of risk factors ( p < 0.05). High cervical cancer awareness among Syrian women did not translate into preventive action, confirming that knowledge alone is insufficient; therefore, integrating HPV vaccination into the national immunisation program alongside targeted educational efforts is crucially needed.

title: Knowledge, trust, and multidimensional perceptions of human papillomavirus vaccination among women attending a single primary care centre in Astana, Kazakhstan: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Background Kazakhstan reintroduced human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination in 2024, making public confidence and communication important. This study described HPV knowledge and trust in information sources and exploratorily examined vaccine-perception structure and correlates among women attending primary care in Astana. Methods A cross-sectional electronic survey was conducted from 17 January to 28 February 2026 among 221 adult women recruited through convenience sampling. HPV knowledge, source-specific trust, and 16 perception items were assessed. Exploratory psychometric analysis used polychoric correlations, parallel analysis, and principal-axis factor analysis with oblimin rotation to derive preliminary composite measures. Spearman correlations and robust multivariable linear models examined safety concern and perceived effectiveness. A secondary logistic model examined refusal or intention to refuse HPV vaccination for a daughter. Results Mean HPV knowledge was 4.95 ± 3.84 of 12. A five-item safety concern measure (mean 2.34 ± 0.97; α = 0.868; ω = 0.901) and a three-item perceived effectiveness measure (mean 3.20 ± 1.24; α = 0.922; ω = 0.948) were derived. Knowledge correlated negatively with safety concern ( ρ = −0.284, p < 0.001) and positively with perceived effectiveness ( ρ = 0.393, p < 0.001). Safety concern was associated with COVID-19 controversy spillover (B = 0.190, 95% CI 0.043−0.337), earlier-programme distrust (B = 0.197, 95% CI 0.047−0.347), and preference for natural immunity (B = 0.137, 95% CI 0.040−0.234). Higher knowledge (B = 0.061, 95% CI 0.010−0.111) and professional/scientific trust (B = 0.297, 95% CI 0.114−0.480) were associated with greater perceived effectiveness. Forty-nine participants (22.2%) reported refusal or intention to refuse vaccination for a daughter; knowing someone believed to have become seriously ill after vaccination was associated with this response (aOR 7.42, 95% CI 2.60−21.16). Conclusion HPV vaccine perceptions were multidimensional. Knowledge and professional-scientific trust were linked mainly to perceived effectiveness, whereas safety concerns were more strongly related to vaccine narratives. Communication strategies should combine factual education with transparent safety dialogue and clinician communication.

elements_zh.methods: 通过调查评估了 HPV 知识、特定来源的信任度和 16 个认知项目。探索性心理测量分析采用多相关性、平行分析和主轴因子分析与obminin旋转来得出综合测量。使用斯皮尔曼相关性和稳健的多变量线性模型来检查安全性问题和感知有效性。
elements_zh.main_results: 12 项中的平均 HPV 知识为 4.95 ± 3.84。得出了五项安全关注指标(平均值 2.34 ± 0.97;α = 0.868;ω = 0.901)和三项感知有效性指标(平均值 3.20 ± 1.24;α = 0.922;ω = 0.948)。知识与安全担忧呈负相关(ρ = -0.284,p < 0.001),与感知有效性呈正相关(ρ = 0.393,p < 0.001)。安全问题与 COVID-19 争议 跨物种溢出、早期计划的不信任以及对自然免疫的偏好有关。更高的知识和专业/科学信任与更高的感知有效性相关。

title: Determination of methylation status of DAPK gene in salivary gland tumour tissues and its association with HPV 16 & 18 positivity
abstract: Abstract Salivary gland tumours (SGTs) are heterogeneous neoplasms with diagnostic challenges due to morphological diversity. This study explored methylation status of DAPK gene in SGTs and its association with HPV16/18 and p16 protein expression. A total of 45 formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded SGT samples were analysed using immunohistochemistry and methylation-specific PCR. Among the cases, 66.67% were benign and 33.34% malignant. DAPK methylation was associated with tumour type but not with HPV markers. Overall, HPV16 L1, HPV16/18 E6, and p16 expression were observed in 68%, 88%, and 77% of cases, respectively, with a higher frequency noted in benign tumours. Patterns observed through hierarchical clustering suggested potential differences in molecular profiles between benign and malignant SGTs; however, these findings remain exploratory, as this distribution deviates from established HPV biology, where E6 expression is typically associated with malignancy, suggesting potential non-specific immunoreactivity or methodological limitations. Overall, DAPK methylation exhibited a heterogeneous pattern across samples, indicating that epigenetic alterations may occur independently of HPV-driven mechanisms in SGTs. While distinct molecular patterns were observed, their biological significance remains uncertain. In conclusion, this study shows an association between DAPK methylation and tumour type in SGTs but does not support a definitive role of HPV in driving these epigenetic changes. The findings also highlight limitations associated with reliance on IHC without molecular HPV confirmation. Further studies incorporating PCR-based HPV typing, functional validation, and larger cohorts are required to clarify these relationships.

abstract_zh: 摘要 唾液腺肿瘤(SGT)是一种异质性肿瘤,由于形态多样性而具有诊断挑战。本研究探讨了SGT中DAPK基因的甲基化状态及其与HPV16/18和p16蛋白表达的关系。使用免疫组织化学和甲基化特异性 PCR 分析了总共 45 个福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的 SGT 样本。其中良性病例占66.67%,恶性病例占33.34%。DAPK 甲基化与肿瘤类型相关,但与 HPV 标记无关。总体而言,HPV16 L1、HPV16/18 E6 和 p16 表达分别在 68%、88% 和 77% 的病例中观察到,在良性肿瘤中出现频率更高。通过层次聚类观察到的模式表明良性和恶性 SGT 之间的分子谱存在潜在差异;然而,这些发现仍然是探索性的,因为这种分布偏离了已建立的 HPV 生物学,其中 E6 表达通常与恶性肿瘤相关,表明潜在的非特异性免疫反应性或方法学局限性。总体而言,DAPK 甲基化在样本中表现出异质模式,表明表观遗传改变可能独立于 SGT 中 HPV 驱动的机制而发生。虽然观察到了不同的分子模式,但它们的生物学意义仍然不确定。总之,这项研究表明 DAPK 甲基化与 SGT 中的肿瘤类型之间存在关联,但不支持 HPV 在驱动这些表观遗传变化中的明确作用。研究结果还强调了在没有 HPV 分子确认的情况下依赖 IHC 的局限性。需要进一步研究结合基于 PCR 的 HPV 分型、功能验证和更大的 队列研究 来阐明这些关系。

title: Prevalence and genotype distribution characteristics of human papillomavirus infection among male outpatients in Putian, Fujian Province: a retrospective study
abstract: Previous research focusing on male human papillomavirus (HPV) prevalence within Putian has not yet been reported. This study aims to investigate the epidemiological prevalence and genotype distribution of HPV among males in the Putian region of Fujian Province, providing empirical evidence to optimize male HPV screening and regional prevention strategies. A total of 731 male outpatients from the First Hospital of Putian city were retrospectively enrolled between May 2023 and February 2026. The enrolled patients were stratified into six subgroups according to their primary clinical diagnoses, including warts, urinary tract infections (UTIs), dermatitis, genital diseases, health check-ups, and others. The detection of 21 HPV genotypes was performed using polymerase chain reaction (PCR) amplification combined with flow-through hybridization technology. The overall HPV prevalence was 35.2%, including 22.7% single-genotype infections and 12.5% multiple-genotype infections, with the highest observed prevalence in patients aged > 60 years. The five most frequent genotypes were HPV6, HPV52, HPV16, HPV51, and HPV42, showing substantial overlap with the predominant genotypes previously reported in local females, including low-risk HPV (LR-HPV) types HPV6, HPV42 and high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) types HPV52, HPV51, and HPV16. Furthermore, HPV prevalence varied significantly across distinct clinical diagnoses ( p = 0.019); the “warts” group exhibited the highest rate (48.7%, predominantly HPV6/11), followed by the dermatitis group (46.5%, displaying high genotype diversity including HPV52, 16, 42, 51, and 59). Multivariable regression analysis identified dermatitis as an independent risk factor for HR-HPV infection. Notably, even with the 9-valent (9 v) HPV vaccine, substantial coverage gaps of 33.5% and 33.9% persisted among the overall HPV-positive and HR-HPV cohorts, respectively. Male outpatients in the Putian region exhibit a high HPV prevalence with distinct age- and disease-specific genotype distributions. The substantial overlap in predominant HPV genotypes between male outpatients and local females highlights the importance of including men in HPV prevention strategies. This finding may support future evaluation of partner-oriented prevention approaches.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究针对福建省莆田市男性HPV 患病率前期研究的不足,旨在调查该地区男性HPV 患病率的流行病学情况及基因型分布。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 方法回顾性研究2023年5月至2026年2月莆田市第一医院门诊男性患者731例。根据患者的主要临床诊断,将患者分为六个亚组。
elements_zh.methods: 采用聚合酶链式反应(PCR)扩增结合流通杂交技术对21种HPV基因型进行检测。使用多变量回归分析来确定 HR-HPV 感染的危险因素。
elements_zh.main_results: HPV 患病率 总体感染率为 35.2%,其中单基因型感染率为 22.7%,多基因型感染率为 12.5%。最常见的五种基因型是 HPV6、HPV52、HPV16、HPV51 和 HPV42,与之前报道的当地女性的主要基因型有很大重叠。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了莆田地区男性门诊患者中不同年龄和疾病特异性的基因型分布,为男性HPV感染的流行病学模式提供了经验证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了将男性纳入 HPV 预防策略的重要性,因为男性和女性之间主要基因型的大量重叠表明共同的风险因素和以伴侣为导向的预防方法的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制,但由于使用PCR和流通杂交技术进行基因型检测以及使用多变量回归分析进行危险因素识别,因此证据充足。

abstract_zh: 此前针对莆田地区男性人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 患病率的研究尚未见报道。本研究旨在调查福建省莆田地区男性HPV流行病学患病率及基因型分布,为优化男性HPV筛查和区域预防策略提供经验依据。回顾性纳入2023年5月至2026年2月莆田市第一医院门诊男性患者731例。根据主要临床诊断将患者分为6个亚组,包括疣、尿路感染(UTI)、皮炎、生殖器疾病、健康检查等。采用聚合酶链式反应(PCR)扩增结合流通杂交技术对21种HPV基因型进行检测。HPV 患病率 总体率为 35.2%,其中单基因型感染率为 22.7%,多基因型感染率为 12.5%,患病率 在年龄 > 60 岁的患者中观察到最高。最常见的五种基因型是 HPV6、HPV52、HPV16、HPV51 和 HPV42,与之前报道的本地女性的主要基因型有很大重叠,包括低危 HPV (LR-HPV) 型 HPV6、HPV42 和 高危型HPV (HR-HPV) 型 HPV52、HPV51 和 HPV16。此外,HPV 患病率 在不同的临床诊断中存在显着差异 (p = 0.019);“疣”组的感染率最高(48.7%,主要是HPV6/11),其次是皮炎组(46.5%,表现出高基因型多样性,包括HPV52、16、42、51和59)。多变量回归分析确定皮炎是 HR-HPV 感染的独立危险因素。值得注意的是,即使使用 9 价 (9 v) HPV 疫苗,总体 HPV 阳性和 HR-HPV 队列研究 之间的覆盖率差距仍然分别为 33.5% 和 33.9%。莆田地区的男性门诊患者表现出高HPV 患病率,且具有明显的年龄和疾病特异性基因型分布。男性门诊患者和当地女性之间主要 HPV 基因型的大量重叠凸显了将男性纳入 HPV 预防策略的重要性。这一发现可能支持未来对以合作伙伴为导向的预防方法的评估。

title: Prevalence and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus among 15,224 gynecological outpatients in Xuzhou, China, during 2023–2025
abstract: Objective This study investigated HPV prevalence and genotype distribution among gynecological outpatients at the Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University, aiming to inform region-specific cervical cancer prevention strategies. Methods We determined the HPV subtypes by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and analyzed the HPV prevalence, genotype distribution in 15,224 gynecological outpatients by age group and year. Results Among the 15,224 outpatients, 4,884 (32.08%) tested positive for HPV, with single high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) infection being the predominant pattern (16.48%). The top five HR-HPV genotypes were HPV52 (5.58%), 16 (4.93%), 58 (4.49%), 53 (3.54%), and 56 (2.51%). The top three low-risk HPV (LR-HPV) genotypes were HPV42 (3.30%), 81 (2.16%), and 43 (1.76%). From 2023 to 2025, the overall HPV prevalence among this study population exhibited a significant increasing trend, rising from 27.57 to 36.63% ( p(linear by linear) < 0.001 ). Overall HPV prevalence differed significantly across age groups ( p < 0.001 ), exhibiting a bimodal distribution, with the highest rate in the ≤24 years group (42.30%), followed by the 55–64 years group (37.29%) and the ≥65 years group (36.43%), and the lowest in the 25–34 years group (29.05%). Across age groups, the top five HR-HPV genotypes varied slightly but consistently included HPV52, 16, 58, 53, and 56. For LR-HPV infections, the top three genotypes were HPV6, 42, and 11 in the ≤24 years group, whereas HPV42, 81, and 43 ranked as the top three in all other age groups. Conclusion The prevalence of HPV infection among women attending gynecological outpatient clinics of the Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University is relatively high and has demonstrated an increasing trend over the study period. Adolescents and middle-aged and older women exhibit higher HPV prevalence. The predominant genotypes are HR-HPV52, 16, 58, 53, and 56, as well as LR-HPV42, 81, and 43. In addition to strengthening universal health education, the observed age-specific distribution suggests that young women and middle-aged and older women may be important target groups for future prevention strategies. Furthermore, the high prevalence of non-vaccine-covered genotypes (HPV53, 56, 42, 81, and 43) warrants continued surveillance and further investigation of their clinical significance, although these implications should be considered preliminary.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查妇科门诊患者中的 患病率 和 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 基因型分布,为特定地区的 宫颈癌 预防策略提供参考。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2023年至2025年徐州医科大学附属医院15224名妇科门诊患者的HPV 患病率和基因型分布,并按年龄组和年份进行分层。
elements_zh.methods: 使用聚合酶链式反应 (PCR) 确定 HPV 亚型,并分析不同年龄组和年份的 患病率 和基因型分布。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 观察到的HPV基因型的年龄分布表明,年轻女性和中老年女性可能是未来预防策略的重要目标群体。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要针对非 疫苗 覆盖的 HPV 基因型制定有针对性的预防策略和持续 监测,特别是在年轻和中年女性中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于单个机构的门诊数据,这可能会限制普遍性。总体 HPV 患病率 在不同年龄组之间存在显着差异 (p < 0.001),表明与年龄有很强的相关性。

title: β-glucans in HPV-Associated cervical cancer: current evidence and translational challenges
abstract: Cervical cancer continues to be a major cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide despite advances in screening and HPV vaccination. Limitations of current therapeutic approaches, including toxicity, resistance, and suboptimal efficacy in advanced disease, have stimulated interest in complementary immunomodulatory strategies. β-glucans, naturally occurring polysaccharides derived from fungi, yeast, bacteria, cereals, and algae, have attracted increasing attention for their immunoregulatory and drug-delivery capabilities. Preclinical evidence, largely derived from non-cervical tumor models, indicates that β-glucans can modulate innate and adaptive immunity through receptors such as Dectin-1, complement receptor 3 (CR3), and Toll-like receptors, potentially remodeling the tumor microenvironment and enhancing antitumor responses. Direct evidence in cervical cancer remains comparatively limited but is emerging: a small randomized controlled trial recently demonstrated improved HPV clearance with topical β-glucans therapy, and historical trials from the 1980s-1990s reported benefit as a radiotherapy adjuvant in invasive cervical cancer, alongside direct cytotoxic activity observed in cervical cancer cell lined in vitro. In parallel, β-glucans-based delivery systems have shown potential for improving the stability, targeting, and controlled release of anticancer agents, though these platforms have likewise been validated primarily in non-cervical models. This review critically distinguishes cervical-specific evidence from findings extrapolated from other malignancies, identifies key evidence gap, including the scarcity of HPV-focused mechanistic studies and standardized formulations, and outlines priorities for future research toward the clinical translation of β-glucans in cervical cancer management.

abstract_zh: 尽管筛查和 HPV 疫苗接种 取得了进展,但 宫颈癌 仍然是全世界癌症相关发病率和 死亡率 的主要原因。当前治疗方法的局限性,包括毒性、耐药性和晚期疾病的次优疗效,激发了人们对补充免疫调节策略的兴趣。β-葡聚糖是源自真菌、酵母、细菌、谷物和藻类的天然多糖,因其免疫调节和药物输送能力而受到越来越多的关注。主要来自非宫颈肿瘤模型的临床前证据表明,β-葡聚糖可以通过 Dectin-1、补体受体 3 (CR3) 和 Toll 样受体等受体调节先天性和适应性免疫,可能重塑肿瘤微环境并增强抗肿瘤反应。宫颈癌 的直接证据仍然相对有限,但正在出现:一项小型随机对照试验最近证明,局部 β-葡聚糖治疗可改善 HPV 清除率,1980 年代至 1990 年代的历史试验报道了作为侵入性 宫颈癌 放疗佐剂的益处,同时在体外排列的 宫颈癌 细胞中观察到直接细胞毒性活性。与此同时,基于 β-葡聚糖的递送系统已显示出改善抗癌药物的稳定性、靶向性和控制释放的潜力,尽管这些平台同样主要在非宫颈模型中得到验证。这篇综述严格地区分了宫颈特异性证据与从其他恶性肿瘤推断的发现,确定了关键证据差距,包括缺乏以 HPV 为重点的机制研究和标准化配方,并概述了未来在 宫颈癌 治疗中将 β-葡聚糖临床转化的研究重点。

title: Perceived knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward genital warts and HPV vaccination among college students in Shandong Province, China
abstract: Objective This study aimed to investigate the perceived knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding genital warts and HPV vaccination among college students in Shandong Province, China. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted on Chinese college students from March 13 to April 2, 2026, in four universities in Shandong Province, China. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire in Chinese that was newly developed for this study and covered demographic characteristics and the three dimensions of the knowledge–attitude–practice (KAP) framework: perceived knowledge (14 items, score range 0–28), attitude (9 items, score range 9–45), and practice (10 items, score range 10–50). Bloom's cut-off criteria were applied to the attainable range of each scale, calculated as (observed score – minimum possible score) / (maximum possible score – minimum possible score) × 100%, and scores were classified as poor (< 60%), moderate (60%−79%), or good (≥80%). Structural equation modeling (SEM) was used to examine the associations among perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice. Results A total of 959 participants were included, with 58.39% of participants being male. The mean perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were 15.34 ± 7.64, 35.92 ± 7.42, and 36.84 ± 11.71, corresponding to 54.79%, 74.78%, and 67.10% of the attainable range of each scale, and therefore to poor perceived knowledge and moderate attitude and practice. In the SEM, perceived knowledge was directly associated with attitude (β = 0.119, P = 0.012) and with practice (β = 0.461, P = 0.014), and attitude was directly associated with practice (β = 0.118, P = 0.007). An indirect association between perceived knowledge and practice through attitude was also observed (β = 0.014, P = 0.003). Perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were positively correlated with each other (all P < 0.001). Conclusion College students in Shandong Province, China had poor perceived knowledge and moderate attitudes and practices regarding genital warts and HPV vaccination. Perceived knowledge showed the strongest association with the practice construct in the specified SEM, with attitude acting as a modest indirect association through attitude. Because the design was cross-sectional; these findings represent associations rather than causal effects. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查中国山东省大学生对尖锐湿疣和HPV 疫苗接种的认知、态度和行为。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2026年3月13日至4月2日,对中国山东省四所大学的中国大学生进行了一项横断面研究。共纳入 959 名参与者,其中男性占 58.39%。
elements_zh.methods: 数据采用中文自填问卷收集,该问卷是为本研究新开发的,涵盖人口特征和知识-态度-实践(KAP)框架的三个维度:感知知识(14个项目,得分范围0-28)、态度(9个项目,得分范围9-45)和实践(10个项目,得分范围10-50)。
elements_zh.main_results: 感知知识、态度和实践的平均得分分别为 15.34 ± 7.64、35.92 ± 7.42 和 36.84 ± 11.71,对应于每个量表可达到范围的 54.79%、74.78% 和 67.10%,因此属于感知知识较差、态度和实践中等的情况。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 感知知识与态度(β = 0.119,P = 0.012)和实践(β = 0.461,P = 0.014)直接相关,态度与实践直接相关(β = 0.118,P = 0.007)。还观察到通过态度感知的知识和实践之间存在间接关联(β = 0.014,P = 0.003)。

title_zh: 中国山东省大学生对尖锐湿疣和HPV 疫苗接种的认知、态度和行为
source_body_en: Objective This study aimed to investigate the perceived knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding genital warts and HPV vaccination among college students in Shandong Province, China. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted on Chinese college students from March 13 to April 2, 2026, in four universities in Shandong Province, China. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire in Chinese that was newly developed for this study and covered demographic characteristics and the three dimensions of the knowledge–attitude–practice (KAP) framework: perceived knowledge (14 items, score range 0–28), attitude (9 items, score range 9–45), and practice (10 items, score range 10–50). Bloom's cut-off criteria were applied to the attainable range of each scale, calculated as (observed score – minimum possible score) / (maximum possible score – minimum possible score) × 100%, and scores were classified as poor (< 60%), moderate (60%−79%), or good (≥80%). Structural equation modeling (SEM) was used to examine the associations among perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice. Results A total of 959 participants were included, with 58.39% of participants being male. The mean perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were 15.34 ± 7.64, 35.92 ± 7.42, and 36.84 ± 11.71, corresponding to 54.79%, 74.78%, and 67.10% of the attainable range of each scale, and therefore to poor perceived knowledge and moderate attitude and practice. In the SEM, perceived knowledge was directly associated with attitude (β = 0.119, P = 0.012) and with practice (β = 0.461, P = 0.014), and attitude was directly associated with practice (β = 0.118, P = 0.007). An indirect association between perceived knowledge and practice through attitude was also observed (β = 0.014, P = 0.003). Perceived knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were positively correlated with each other (all P < 0.001). Conclusion College students in Shandong Province, China had poor perceived knowledge and moderate attitudes and practices regarding genital warts and HPV vaccination. Perceived knowledge showed the strongest association with the practice construct in the specified SEM, with attitude acting as a modest indirect association through attitude. Because the design was cross-sectional; these findings represent associations rather than causal effects. Campus-based sexual health education should prioritize accurate HPV-related knowledge, male vaccination awareness, and accessible referral pathways for STI examination and HPV vaccination.
abstract_zh: 目的 调查山东省大学生对尖锐湿疣和HPV 疫苗接种的认知、态度和行为。方法对2026年3月13日至4月2日在中国山东省四所大学的中国大学生进行横断面研究。数据采用中文自填问卷收集,该问卷是为本研究新开发的,涵盖人口特征和知识-态度-实践(KAP)框架的三个维度:感知知识(14个项目,得分范围0-28)、态度(9个项目,得分范围9-45)和实践(10个项目,得分范围10-50)。布鲁姆截止标准适用于每个量表的可达到范围,计算公式为(观察分数 - 最低可能分数)/(最大可能分数 - 最低可能分数)× 100%,分数分为差(< 60%)、中等(60%−79%)或良好(≥80%)。结构方程模型(SEM)用于检查感知知识、态度和实践之间的关联。结果共纳入959名参与者,其中男性占58.39%。感知知识、态度和实践的平均得分分别为 15.34 ± 7.64、35.92 ± 7.42 和 36.84 ± 11.71,对应于每个量表可达到范围的 54.79%、74.78% 和 67.10%,因此属于感知知识较差、态度和实践中等的情况。在SEM中,感知知识与态度(β = 0.119,P = 0.012)和实践(β = 0.461,P = 0.014)直接相关,态度与实践直接相关(β = 0.118,P = 0.007)。还观察到通过态度感知的知识和实践之间存在间接关联(β = 0.014,P = 0.003)。感知知识、态度和实践得分均呈正相关(均 P < 0.001)。结论 山东省大学生对尖锐湿疣和HPV 疫苗接种的认知水平较差,态度和行为较差。在指定的 SEM 中,感知知识显示出与实践结构的最强关联,而态度则通过态度起到了适度的间接关联的作用。因为设计是横截面的;这些发现代表的是关联性而不是因果效应。校园性健康教育应优先考虑准确的 HPV 相关知识、男性 疫苗接种 意识以及可访问的 STI 检查和 HPV 疫苗接种 转诊途径。

title: Human papillomavirus self-sampling for cervical cancer screening in Portugal: a mixed-methods acceptability study among socially vulnerable migrant women
abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer is a public health concern. Although it is preventable through regular screening, participation in screening programmes remains suboptimal among women living in socially vulnerable situations and migrants due to barriers to conventional screening programmes. Consequently, these women experience disproportionately higher incidence and mortality rates, underscoring inequities in cervical cancer outcomes. Human Papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling has emerged as a promising strategy to mitigate these barriers and enhance access to preventive reproductive health services. However, evidence of its acceptability in community settings is limited. Drawing on a culturally adapted HPV self-sampling intervention, this study aimed to explore the acceptability of HPV self-sampling among socially vulnerable migrant women in community settings in Lisbon. Methods We conducted a sequential mixed-methods study among 111 socially vulnerable migrant women aged 30–65 years who participated in an HPV self-sampling intervention delivered through community-based organisations in Lisbon. The quantitative component consisted of a pre–post questionnaire assessing anticipated and experienced acceptability of HPV self-sampling. The qualitative component involved mini–focus group discussions with eight intervention participants to explore experiences in greater depth. Quantitative data were analysed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test in R, and qualitative data were analysed thematically informed by the Theoretical Framework of Acceptability. Results Our findings indicate high perceived acceptability of HPV self-sampling. Pre–post comparisons showed statistically significant changes (p < 0.05) in trust in test results, perceived ease and comfort, confidence in self-sampling, and the speed of the process, alongside reductions in pain, nervousness, embarrassment, and the need for help. Qualitative data contextualised these findings: women valued the privacy, simplicity, and trust. However, concerns regarding correct test performance and positive results were identified. Clear instructions and community settings emerged as perceived enablers. Conclusion HPV self-sampling was perceived as acceptable among socially vulnerable migrant women. These findings may inform considerations for cervical cancer screening implementation aimed at expanding access to cervical cancer prevention with respect to how HPV self-sampling is introduced, facilitated, and supported within trusted community settings. Further research is needed to assess whether perceived acceptability translates into sustained screening uptake and equitable screening participation across diverse implementation settings.

Results Our findings indicate high perceived acceptability of HPV self-sampling. Pre–post comparisons showed statistically significant changes (p < 0.05) in trust in test results, perceived ease and comfort, confidence in self-sampling, and the speed of the process, alongside reductions in pain, nervousness, embarrassment, and the need for help. source_body_en: Abstract Background Cervical cancer is a public health concern. Although it is preventable through regular screening, participation in screening programmes remains suboptimal among women living in socially vulnerable situations and migrants due to barriers to conventional screening programmes. Consequently, these women experience disproportionately higher incidence and mortality rates, underscoring inequities in cervical cancer outcomes. Human Papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling has emerged as a promising strategy to mitigate these barriers and enhance access to preventive reproductive health services. However, evidence of its acceptability in community settings is limited. Drawing on a culturally adapted HPV self-sampling intervention, this study aimed to explore the acceptability of HPV self-sampling among socially vulnerable migrant women in community settings in Lisbon. Methods We conducted a sequential mixed-methods study among 111 socially vulnerable migrant women aged 30–65 years who participated in an HPV self-sampling intervention delivered through community-based organisations in Lisbon. The quantitative component consisted of a pre–post questionnaire assessing anticipated and experienced acceptability of HPV self-sampling. The qualitative component involved mini–focus group discussions with eight intervention participants to explore experiences in greater depth. Quantitative data were analysed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test in R, and qualitative data were analysed thematically informed by the Theoretical Framework of Acceptability. Results Our findings indicate high perceived acceptability of HPV self-sampling. Pre–post comparisons showed statistically significant changes (p < 0.05) in trust in test results, perceived ease and comfort, confidence in self-sampling, and the speed of the process, alongside reductions in pain, nervousness, embarrassment, and the need for help. Qualitative data contextualised these findings: women valued the privacy, simplicity, and trust. However, concerns regarding correct test performance and positive results were identified. Clear instructions and community settings emerged as perceived enablers. Conclusion HPV self-sampling was perceived as acceptable among socially vulnerable migrant women. These findings may inform considerations for cervical cancer screening implementation aimed at expanding access to cervical cancer prevention with respect to how HPV self-sampling is introduced, facilitated, and supported within trusted community settings. Further research is needed to assess whether perceived acceptability translates into sustained screening uptake and equitable screening participation across diverse implementation settings.
abstract_zh: 摘要背景 宫颈癌 是一个公共卫生问题。尽管可以通过定期筛查来预防,但由于传统筛查计划存在障碍,生活在社会弱势群体的妇女和移民对筛查计划的参与仍然不够理想。因此,这些女性的 发病率 和 死亡率 率不成比例地较高,凸显了 宫颈癌 结果的不平等。人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 自我采样已成为一种有前途的策略,可以减轻这些障碍并增加获得预防性生殖健康服务的机会。然而,其在社区环境中可接受性的证据有限。本研究借鉴适应文化的 HPV 自我采样干预措施,旨在探讨里斯本社区环境中社会弱势移民妇女对 HPV 自我采样的接受程度。方法 我们对 111 名 30-65 岁的社会弱势移民女性进行了一项序贯混合方法研究,她们参加了里斯本社区组织提供的 HPV 自我采样干预措施。定量部分包括评估 HPV 自我采样的预期和经验可接受性的事前调查问卷。定性部分包括与八名干预参与者进行小型焦点小组讨论,以更深入地探索经验。使用 R 中的 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验对定量数据进行分析,并根据可接受性理论框架对定性数据进行主题分析。结果 我们的研究结果表明 HPV 自我采样的接受度很高。前后比较显示,在对测试结果的信任度、感知的轻松度和舒适度、对自我采样的信心以及过程速度方面发生了统计上显着的变化(p < 0.05),同时疼痛、紧张、尴尬和对帮助的需求也减少了。定性数据体现了这些发现:女性重视隐私、简单和信任。然而,人们发现了对正确测试性能和阳性结果的担忧。明确的指示和社区设置被视为推动因素。结论 HPV 自我采样在社会弱势流动妇女中被认为是可以接受的。这些发现可能会为 宫颈癌 筛查实施的考虑提供参考,该筛查旨在扩大 宫颈癌 预防的可及性,涉及如何在受信任的社区环境中引入、促进和支持 HPV 自我采样。需要进一步的研究来评估感知的可接受性是否转化为在不同实施环境中持续的筛查采用和公平的筛查参与。

title: Acceptability and preference of self-collected vaginal samples for human papillomavirus DNA testing compared with physician-collected Pap smear.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Self-collected vaginal sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing provides a promising alternative to physician-collected Pap smears, especially in low-resource settings. However, data on its acceptability and preferences among Filipino women remain limited. This study aimed to assess women's perceptions, experiences, willingness and preferences regarding self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing compared with Pap smears. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 592 women. Participants underwent both physician-collected Pap smears and self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing. Perceptions were measured using five-point Likert scale questionnaires before and after self-collection. Descriptive statistics were used, and paired and independent Wilcoxon tests were used to compare Likert responses. Willingness to undergo screening was analyzed with Cochran's Q and McNemar tests. Participants' reasons for their preferred screening method were categorized thematically and displayed in stacked bar charts. RESULTS: Self-collection was generally viewed as painless, not uncomfortable, non-embarrassing, and easy and convenient. Acceptability significantly increased after participants performed self-collection (P < 0.001 for pain and discomfort). Compared with Pap smears, self-collection was seen as less embarrassing (P < 0.001), but rated as less easy (P = 0.01) and less convenient (P = 0.004). Most participants preferred physician-administered screening (84.8%) due to trust in medical expertise, and confidence in the procedure's accuracy, safety and cleanliness. CONCLUSIONS: Self-collected vaginal sampling was highly acceptable, yet physician-collected screening remained the preferred method. Improving education, demonstrations, and support for self-collection may enhance the uptake of HPV DNA testing and broaden access to cervical cancer screening in the Philippines.

title_zh: 自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒 DNA检测的可接受性和偏好性与医生采集的巴氏涂片比较
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Self-collected vaginal sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing provides a promising alternative to physician-collected Pap smears, especially in low-resource settings. However, data on its acceptability and preferences among Filipino women remain limited. This study aimed to assess women's perceptions, experiences, willingness and preferences regarding self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing compared with Pap smears. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 592 women. Participants underwent both physician-collected Pap smears and self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing. Perceptions were measured using five-point Likert scale questionnaires before and after self-collection. Descriptive statistics were used, and paired and independent Wilcoxon tests were used to compare Likert responses. Willingness to undergo screening was analyzed with Cochran's Q and McNemar tests. Participants' reasons for their preferred screening method were categorized thematically and displayed in stacked bar charts. RESULTS: Self-collection was generally viewed as painless, not uncomfortable, non-embarrassing, and easy and convenient. Acceptability significantly increased after participants performed self-collection (P < 0.001 for pain and discomfort). Compared with Pap smears, self-collection was seen as less embarrassing (P < 0.001), but rated as less easy (P = 0.01) and less convenient (P = 0.004). Most participants preferred physician-administered screening (84.8%) due to trust in medical expertise, and confidence in the procedure's accuracy, safety and cleanliness. CONCLUSIONS: Self-collected vaginal sampling was highly acceptable, yet physician-collected screening remained the preferred method. Improving education, demonstrations, and support for self-collection may enhance the uptake of HPV DNA testing and broaden access to cervical cancer screening in the Philippines.
abstract_zh: 背景:自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)DNA检测为医生采集的巴氏涂片提供了一种有前景的替代方案,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中。然而,关于菲律宾女性对其可接受性和偏好的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估女性对自我采集阴道样本进行HPV DNA检测与巴氏涂片的感知、体验、意愿和偏好。方法:在592名女性中进行了一项横断面研究。参与者接受了医生采集的巴氏涂片和自我采集的阴道样本用于HPV DNA检测。使用五点李克特量表问卷在自我采集前后测量感知。采用描述性统计分析,并使用配对和独立Wilcoxon检验比较李克特量表回答。使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析接受筛查的意愿。参与者偏好的筛查方法的原因被主题分类,并以堆叠条形图显示。结果:自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。结论:自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现可以为提高HPV DNA检测参与率和扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性提供策略依据,强调了对自我采集方法进行教育和支持的必要性。局限性与证据强度:本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和自我报告数据,这可能引入偏倚。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于可接受性和偏好的见解,但并未建立因果关系。

title: Atypical presentations of Lhermitte's sign after treatment for human papillomavirus-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
abstract: Lhermitte's sign (LS) is characterised by a brief electric shock-like sensation elicited by neck flexion that radiates down the spine and may extend into the posterior aspects of the legs. It is a clinical indicator of cervical or upper thoracic dorsal column dysfunction, most commonly due to demyelination or intrinsic spinal cord pathology. It may occur after head and neck (chemo)radiotherapy. We describe two patients with human papillomavirus-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma who developed LS following chemoradiotherapy. One patient developed protracted LS lasting 20 months beyond completion of definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy with volumetric modulated arc radiotherapy and weekly cisplatin and another patient developed protracted LS after adjuvant de-escalated volumetric modulated arc radiotherapy lasting 12 months beyond treatment completion. These cases show the variable course of LS in the modern conformal era and highlight its benign prognosis but potential for persistent symptoms that affect patient quality of life.

title: A structural equation modeling analysis of human papillomavirus preventive behaviors among women in Southwest Iran based on the health belief model
abstract: HPV contributes substantially to the global burden of cervical cancer and exhibits considerable genotypic diversity in southwestern Iran. Therefore, understanding the determinants of preventive behaviors is essential. Given the persistent gaps in awareness and uptake of preventive measures, this study employs the Health Belief Model and structural equation modeling to identify the psychological and demographic factors shaping women’s engagement in HPV preventive behaviors. A cross-sectional study was carried out among women attending four comprehensive health centers in Behbahan, southwest Iran (2024–2025). Demographic data and HBM-related constructs were assessed using a validated questionnaire. Confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling were employed to evaluate measurement validity and examine predictors of HPV preventive behaviors. Among 820 women (mean age = 36.78 ± 8.95 years), perceived susceptibility, self-efficacy, and perceived barriers were significantly associated with HPV preventive behaviors. SEM showed excellent model fit (CFI = 0.96, RMSEA = 0.04) and identified significant effects of perceived susceptibility (β = 0.34, p < 0.001), self-efficacy (β = 0.31, p < 0.001), and perceived barriers (β = − 0.28, p < 0.001) on preventive behaviors. The findings highlight that psychological factors, particularly perceived susceptibility, self-efficacy, and perceived barriers, are significantly associated with women’s engagement in HPV preventive behaviors. Interventions addressing these factors may be associated with improved preventive practices in southwestern Iran.

title: Conhecimento, atitude e prática sobre vacina papilomavírus humano entre adolescentes negros: revisão de escopo Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding the human papillomavirus vaccine among black adolescents: a scoping review
abstract: Objetivo: mapear o conhecimento, atitudes e práticas sobre a vacina papilomavírus humano entre adolescentes negros. Métodos: revisão de escopo realizada conforme as diretrizes do JBI. Foram incluídos estudos com texto completo, publicados a partir do ano de 2006, sem restrição do idioma. A triagem e seleção foram realizadas por duas pesquisadoras independentes no software Rayyan. Os dados foram extraídos por meio de instrumento elaborado pelas autoras e apresentados de forma descritiva. Resultados: foram encontrados 1.120 estudos, sendo sete deles incluídos na amostra final. As publicações compreenderam o período entre 2010 e 2021. Os estudos evidenciaram conhecimento limitado sobre papilomavírus humano e vacinação entre adolescentes negros. Embora parte das investigações tenha identificado atitudes favoráveis à vacina, a prática vacinal permaneceu abaixo do esperado. Conclusão: apesar de as atitudes ante a vacina papilomavírus humano serem predominantemente favoráveis, o conhecimento limitado e as barreiras informacionais, culturais e estruturais dificultam a vacinação efetiva. Contribuições para a prática: os achados reforçam a necessidade de fortalecer ações de educação em saúde sobre a vacinação entre adolescentes negros, por meio de abordagens culturalmente sensíveis, favorecendo o enfrentamento da desinformação e o aumento da confiança na vacina nessa população específica.

title_original: Conhecimento, atitude e prática sobre vacina papilomavírus humano entre adolescentes negros: revisão de escopo Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding the human papillomavirus vaccine among black adolescents: a scoping review

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to map knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among black adolescents. The central question is focused on understanding the extent of awareness, acceptance, and implementation of HPV vaccination in this specific demographic.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A scoping review was conducted following the JBI guidelines. The evidence base includes studies with full text, published from 2006 onwards, without language restrictions. Two researchers independently performed screening and selection using the Rayyan software. Data were extracted using an instrument developed by the authors and presented descriptively.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identified seven studies included in the final sample, published between 2010 and 2021. These studies revealed limited knowledge about HPV and vaccination among black adolescents. While some investigations found favorable attitudes toward the vaccine, vaccination practices remained below expectations.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights heterogeneity in the findings, with limited knowledge about HPV and vaccination among black adolescents. There is a lack of comprehensive data on the specific barriers influencing vaccination practices in this population, including cultural, informational, and structural factors.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings emphasize the need for culturally sensitive health education initiatives targeting black adolescents to address misinformation and enhance vaccine confidence. There is a clear call for further research to explore the underlying factors affecting vaccination rates and to develop targeted interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review explores knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among black adolescents. Conducted using JBI guidelines, the review included seven studies published between 2010 and 2021. The results indicate limited knowledge about HPV and vaccination, with some favorable attitudes but suboptimal vaccination practices. The review identifies cultural, informational, and structural barriers as key challenges. It underscores the need for culturally sensitive health education to improve vaccine confidence and uptake in this population.

title: A Study to Assess the Knowledge and Attitude on Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) Vaccination among Adolescents Girls in Selected School of Durgapur, West Bengal
abstract: Background: Human Papilloma virus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted infections globally and is a leading cause of cervical cancer among women. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), nearly all cases of cervical cancer can be attributed to HPV infection, particularly types 16 and 18. Objectives: To assess the level of knowledge and attitude regarding HPV vaccination among adolescent girls. To determine the co-relation between the level of knowledge and attitude regarding HPV vaccination. Material and Method: A Cross-sectional descriptive research design was used. A purposive sampling technique was used to enroll 100 adolescent girls. A Self- administered structured questionnaire was used to collect the data. Data obtained were tabulated and analyzed in terms of objectives of the study using descriptive and inferential statistics. Conclusion: The findings of the study showed that majority of adolescent girls (47%) have average level of knowledge, 44% of adolescent girls have inadequate level of knowledge and 9% of adolescent girls have adequate knowledge on HPV Vaccination. 54% of adolescent girls have neutral level of attitude, 43% adolescent girls have non-favorable level of attitude and 3% adolescent girls have favorable attitude on HPV Vaccination. The mean value of knowledge and attitude score was 25.37 and 24.94 respectively. Obtained r value is 0.701. Therefore, there was a strong correlation present between knowledge and attitude on HPV Vaccination.
journal: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)

title: Genotype Distribution Characteristics and Short-Term Follow-Up of HPV Infection Among Male Outpatients in Wenzhou, China
abstract: Objective: The aim of this study was to investigate the genotype distribution, co-infection patterns, and disease-specific characteristics of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection among male outpatients in Wenzhou, China. Methods: A total of 1934 male outpatients who underwent HPV genotyping at Wenzhou People’s Hospital and Wenzhou Maternal and Child Health Hospital between April 2023 and March 2026 were enrolled. Baseline infection status, clinical manifestations, genotype co-infection patterns, and six-month follow-up outcomes were analyzed. Results: The overall HPV positivity rate was 39.14%. HPV52 was the most prevalent high-risk genotype (13.61%, 95% CI: 11.12–16.43%), most frequently co-detected with HPV51 and HPV58, whereas HPV6 dominated low-risk genotypes (40.16%, 95% CI: 36.69–43.66%). HPV positivity differed significantly across disease groups (p < 0.001), with the highest rate observed in mucocutaneous lesions (58.07%, 95% CI: 53.89–62.18%). Single-genotype infection predominated (73.71%, 95% CI: 70.58–76.85%). Of 757 HPV-positive patients, 403 (53.24%) completed six-month follow-up, and their rates of complete clearance, isolated persistence, incident-only genotype, and superinfection were 52.61%, 28.04%, 13.40%, and 5.96%, respectively. Conclusions: These findings underscore the need for male-specific HPV screening strategies, targeted health education for high-risk populations, and age-stratified individualized follow-up protocols. Such regional epidemiological evidence may help optimize local prevention, intervention, and clinical management of HPV-associated disorders in men.

title: Serological Markers of Selected Sexually Transmitted Infections (HBV, HCV, HIV, and Syphilis) in Patients with Anogenital Warts: A Two-Centre, Five-Year Study
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus-induced disruption of the anogenital mucosal barrier may increase susceptibility to other sexually transmitted infections (STIs), and guidelines recommend STI screening in patients with anogenital warts (AGW). We aimed to determine the seroprevalence of concomitant STIs in patients with AGW over a five-year period and to perform an exploratory assessment of associated demographic factors. Methods: In this retrospective, cross-sectional study, all consecutive patients clinically diagnosed with AGW between December 2020 and October 2025 (n = 779) were evaluated. Serological results for HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HCV, anti-HIV, and syphilis (treponemal and non-treponemal) were obtained. Seroprevalence was estimated with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using the number of patients actually tested as the denominator. Patterns of multiple reactive serological markers were described, and the relationship between age and seropositivity was examined using a Cochran–Armitage trend test. Associations of demographic factors with concomitant STI seropositivity were explored using Fisher’s exact test with Woolf logit CIs and a complementary Firth penalized logistic regression; given the small number of events, these analyses were considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Results: Among 779 patients (585 [75%] male; mean age, 35.80 ± 12.32 years), the overall seroprevalence of concomitant STIs was 2.4% (19/779; 95% CI, 1.6–3.8). Seroprevalence was 1.4% for HBsAg, 0.9% for anti-HCV, 0.2% for anti-HIV, and 1.6% for treponemal antibodies, while anti-HBs immunity was present in 53.5% of patients. Two patients (10.5% of seropositive cases) had more than one concomitant STI. Seropositivity increased from 0.7% in patients aged 17–24 years to 3.5% in those aged ≥45 years, although the trend was not statistically significant (p = 0.13). Anti-HBs negativity was associated with concomitant STI seropositivity (OR = 5.63; 95% CI, 1.60–19.83; p = 0.003); this association was attenuated and no longer statistically significant after excluding HBV markers (OR = 2.73; 95% CI, 0.70–10.69; p = 0.200). A complete-case analysis restricted to patients with a fully defined testing panel yielded a similar prevalence estimate (2.8%; 95% CI, 1.7–4.5). Conclusions: The seroprevalence of the tested markers in patients with AGW was low but non-negligible and increased with age, while the subgroup of markers more consistent with current infection was less common. Anti-HBs negativity was associated with the composite outcome, but a sensitivity analysis showed this was largely attributable to its expected link with HBV status. These findings support guideline-recommended serological screening—including hepatitis B vaccination assessment—in all patients with AGW, and should be regarded as hypothesis-generating given the limited number of seropositive cases.

Methods: In this retrospective, cross-sectional study, all consecutive patients clinically diagnosed with AGW between December 2020 and October 2025 (n = 779) were evaluated. Serological results for HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HCV, anti-HIV, and syphilis (treponemal and non-treponemal) were obtained. Seroprevalence was estimated with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using the number of patients actually tested as the denominator. Patterns of multiple reactive serological markers were described, and the relationship between age and seropositivity was examined using a Cochran–Armitage trend test. Associations of demographic factors with concomitant STI seropositivity were explored using Fisher’s exact test with Woolf logit CIs and a complementary Firth penalized logistic regression; given the small number of events, these analyses were considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Results: Among 779 patients (585 [75%] male; mean age, 35.80 ± 12.32 years), the overall seroprevalence of concomitant STIs was 2.4% (19/779; 95% CI, 1.6–3.8). Seropositivity increased from 0.7% in patients aged 17–24 years to 3.5% in those aged ≥45 years, although the trend was not statistically significant (p = 0.13). It aimed to assess the association between demographic factors and STI seropositivity. The study was conducted at two centres and included 779 patients. Seroprevalence for HBsAg, anti-HCV, anti-HIV, and treponemal antibodies was low, with anti-HBs immunity present in 53.5% of patients. title: Prevalence and co-detection of Helicobacter pylori, Epstein–Barr virus, and human papillomavirus in gastric tissues: a cross-sectional study from Yazd, Iran (2019–2022)
abstract: Background and Objectives: Gastric cancer remains a leading cause of cancer mortality and exhibits significant geographic variation. Although Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is a well-established carcinogen, the contributions of Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) and human papillomavirus (HPV), individually or in conjunction with H. pylori, are not fully understood. This study assessed the prevalence and co-detection of these pathogens in gastric tissues from Yazd, Iran. Materials and Methods: An archive-based cross-sectional study was conducted using 130 formalin-fixed, paraffin-embed- ded (FFPE) gastric specimens collected between 2019 and 2022, comprising 83 gastric adenocarcinomas and 47 non-malig- nant tissues. pylori was detected by conventional PCR targeting 16S rRNA, while EBV and HPV were identified by nested PCR targeting EBNA-1 and L1, respectively. PCR products were confirmed by agarose gel electrophoresis, and selected amplicons were verified by Sanger sequencing. pylori was detected in 74 of 130 specimens (56.9%), with a prevalence of 62.7% in malignant tissues and 46.8% in non-malignant tissues (p=0.080). abstract_zh: 背景和目标:胃癌仍然是癌症的主要原因,并且表现出显着的地理差异。尽管幽门螺杆菌 (H. pylori) 是一种公认​​的致癌物质,但 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 和 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 单独或与幽门螺杆菌联合的作用尚不完全清楚。本研究评估了伊朗亚兹德胃组织中的 患病率 和这些病原体的联合检测。材料和方法:使用 2019 年至 2022 年间收集的 130 份福尔马林固定石蜡包埋 (FFPE) 胃标本进行了一项基于档案的横断面研究,其中包括 83 份胃腺癌和 47 份非恶性组织。幽门螺杆菌通过针对16S rRNA的常规PCR检测,而EBV和HPV分别通过针对EBNA-1和L1的巢式PCR鉴定。PCR产物通过琼脂糖凝胶电泳进行确认,并且选择的扩增子通过Sanger测序进行验证。130 份标本中的 74 份(56.9%)检测到幽门螺杆菌,恶性组织中的 患病率 为 62.7%,非恶性组织中为 46.8%(p=0.080)。在 3 例恶性病例 (3.6%) 中检测到 EBV,在 1 例恶性病例 (1.2%) 中检测到 HPV,在非恶性样本中未发现阳性结果(分别为 p=0.187 和 p=0.450)。在恶性组织中观察到 3 例联合检测,包括 2 例幽门螺杆菌伴 EBV 病例和 1 例 H. pylori 病例。由于 EBV 和 HPV 阳性病例数量有限,关联分析缺乏统计效力。幽门螺杆菌是检测到的主要微生物,而 EBV 和 HPV 很少见,同时检测的情况也​​很少。需要采用补充分子技术和幽门螺杆菌毒力分析进行更大规模的前瞻性研究,以阐明这些感染在胃癌发生中的临床意义。

title: Human Papillomavirus and Prostate Cancer: A Controversial Association
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a sexually transmitted virus which infection can be asymptomatic or appear as mucosal lesions. HPV infection is estimated to contribute to approximately 5% of all cancers worldwide and is strongly associated with the development of most cervical cancers, as well as a substantial proportion of oropharyngeal, penile, and vulvar cancers. The viral HPV proteins E6 and E7 promote the development of tumour cells by disturbing the cellular signalling pathways involving the retinoblastoma protein (pRB) and cellular tumour antigen p53. Due to the established role of HPV in several anogenital cancers, a possible association between HPV infection and prostate cancer (PCa) risk has also been investigated. Recent studies and meta-analyses have reported an association between HPV infection and PCa in some populations. However, the available evidence remains inconsistent, and HPV infection cannot currently be considered an established risk factor for PCa. Further studies are needed to determine whether HPV infection plays a causal role in prostate carcinogenesis and whether HPV detection has clinical or prognostic utility in PCa.

abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是一种性传播病毒,感染可能无症状或表现为粘膜病变。据估计,HPV 感染约占全球所有癌症的 5%,并且与大多数 宫颈癌 以及相当大比例的口咽癌、阴茎癌和外阴癌的发展密切相关。病毒 HPV 蛋白 E6 和 E7 通过扰乱涉及视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白 (pRB) 和细胞肿瘤抗原 p53 的细胞信号传导途径来促进肿瘤细胞的发育。由于 HPV 在几种肛门生殖器癌症中的作用已得到证实,因此还研究了 HPV 感染与前列腺癌 (PCa) 风险之间可能存在的关联。最近的研究和荟萃分析报告了某些人群中 HPV 感染与 PCa 之间的关联。然而,现有的证据仍然不一致,HPV 感染目前不能被视为 PCa 的既定危险因素。需要进一步的研究来确定 HPV 感染是否在前列腺癌发生中起因果作用,以及 HPV 检测是否对 PCa 具有临床或预后作用。

title: Distribution of Human Papillomavirus Genotypes and Co-Infection Patterns Across Anogenital Sites in Female Patients: A Microarray-Based Study
abstract: Background: Cervical cancer is the most common and prevalent health problem, and the leading cause of cervical cancer worldwide is human papillomavirus (HPV). There may be missed opportunities in conventional approaches due to genotype-specific risk and multiple infections. This study aimed to describe the distribution of each genotype and co-infection at anogenital sites in symptomatic Iraqi women. Methods: In this prospective cross-sectional study, 100 women with clinically suspected HPV infection were consecutively enrolled between December 2025 and July 2026. A single specimen was collected from one of seven cervical, vulval, anal, or perianal sites. DNA was extracted using an automated magnetic-bead system, followed by post-PCR microarray hybridization for simultaneous detection of 35 HPV genotypes. Associations were assessed using exact and nonparametric tests. Results: HPV DNA was detected in 65.0% of participants (95% CI, 55.3–73.6%), comprising LR-only (48%), HR/PHR-only (9%), and mixed LR/HR-PHR infections (8%). HPV-6 and HPV-11 predominated, accounting for 40.9% and 30.7% of genotype detections, respectively. Multiple-genotype infections occurred in 20%. Age and sampling site were not significantly associated with HPV risk category. Among HR/PHR detections, 63.2% comprised non-avalent vaccine-covered genotypes. Conclusion: LR genotypes predominated, consistent with a wart-associated profile, while HR/PHR and mixed infections indicate clinically relevant oncogenic risk. Genotype-resolved microarray profiling may strengthen molecular surveillance and risk-informed HPV screening and vaccination strategies in Iraq.

title: Partial sequence of L1 gene in HPV 16 and HPV 18 isolated from head-neck squamous cell carcinoma tissues in Bangladesh
abstract: ABSTRACT Human papillomavirus is one of the most crucial determinants responsible for the progression of head-neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Here, we report partial L1 gene sequences of two high-risk etiological agents, HPV-16 and HPV-18, extracted through biopsies from multiple head-neck tissue regions of HNSCC patients in Bangladesh.

title: Neurological Complications of Oncogenic Viruses: Mechanisms, Clinical Manifestations, and Emerging Insights.
abstract: Oncogenic viruses are widely recognized for their pivotal role in malignant transformation; however, their capacity to induce neurological disorders has received comparatively less attention. Increasing evidence indicates that several oncogenic viruses, including human T-cell leukemia virus type 1 (HTLV-1), human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV), are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological complications involving both the central and peripheral nervous systems. These manifestations arise through diverse mechanisms, including direct viral neuroinvasion, persistent infection, immune-mediated tissue injury, chronic neuroinflammation, and disruption of neurovascular integrity. Moreover, virus-induced molecular alterations, such as oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, epigenetic remodelling, and aberrant cytokine signalling, contribute t neuronal dysfunction and disease progression. In this review, we critically examine the current understanding of the neurological complications associated with major oncogenic viruses by integrating evidence from molecular, experimental, and clinical studies. We first discuss the general mechanisms by which viral infections induce neurological injury, highlighting pathways shared among neurotropic and non-neurotropic viruses. We then summarise the neurological manifestations and virus-specific pathogenic mechanisms associated with each oncogenic virus, emphasising both common and distinct molecular pathways underlying neuropathogenesis. Finally, we address current diagnostic challenges, emerging biomarkers, and therapeutic strategies while identifying critical knowledge gaps that limit causal interpretation and clinical translation. A comprehensive understanding of the complex interactions between oncogenic viruses, the immune system, and the nervous system will facilitate earlier diagnosis, improve patient management, and support the development of targeted therapeutic approaches for virus-associated neurological disorders.

title_zh: 致癌病毒的神经并发症:机制、临床表现和新见解。
source_body_en: Oncogenic viruses are widely recognized for their pivotal role in malignant transformation; however, their capacity to induce neurological disorders has received comparatively less attention. Increasing evidence indicates that several oncogenic viruses, including human T-cell leukemia virus type 1 (HTLV-1), human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV), are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological complications involving both the central and peripheral nervous systems. abstract_zh: 致癌病毒因其在恶性转化中的关键作用而被广泛认可。然而,它们引起神经系统疾病的能力相对较少受到关注。越来越多的证据表明,多种致癌病毒,包括人类 T 细胞白血病病毒 1 型 (HTLV-1)、人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)、乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和卡波西肉瘤相关疱疹病毒 (KSHV),与涉及中枢和周围神经系统的广泛神经系统并发症有关。这些表现是通过多种机制产生的,包括直接病毒神经侵袭、持续感染、免疫介导的组织损伤、慢性神经炎症和神经血管完整性破坏。此外,病毒诱导的分子改变,如氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、表观遗传重塑和异常的细胞因子信号传导,会导致神经元功能障碍和疾病进展。在这篇综述中,我们通过整合分子、实验和临床研究的证据,批判性地研究了目前对与主要致癌病毒相关的神经并发症的理解。我们首先讨论病毒感染引起神经损伤的一般机制,强调嗜神经病毒和非嗜神经病毒之间共享的途径。然后,我们总结了与每种致癌病毒相关的神经学表现和病毒特异性致病机制,强调神经发病机制中常见和独特的分子途径。最后,我们解决当前的诊断挑战、新兴生物标志物和治疗策略,同时确定限制因果解释和临床转化的关键知识差距。全面了解致癌病毒、免疫系统和神经系统之间复杂的相互作用将有助于早期 诊断,改善患者管理,并支持开发针对病毒相关神经系统疾病的靶向治疗方法。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述整合了分子、实验和临床研究的证据,以严格检查 HPV 的神经系统并发症。它讨论了病毒引起的神经损伤的一般机制,然后总结了病毒特异性的致病机制,强调了常见和独特的分子途径。

title: Optimising HPV Vaccination for Cervical Cancer Prevention in Women Living with HIV: A Cost-Effectiveness Analysis Across 13 African Countries
abstract: Abstract Background Women living with HIV (WLHIV) have an increased risk of persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and cervical cancer. We evaluated the lifetime health impact and cost-effectiveness of HPV vaccination strategies targeting WLHIV across 13 African countries. Methods We developed an age-structured Markov model of HPV infection and cervical cancer in a closed cohort of 100,000 females, stratified by HIV status, and calibrated it separately for each country to age-specific cervical cancer incidence, cervical cancer mortality, and female HIV prevalence. Six HIV-targeted strategies were compared with routine two-dose vaccination at age 14 years. The strategies either provided a booster dose to previously vaccinated WLHIV or combined a booster for previously vaccinated WLHIV with a three-dose primary catch-up course for previously unvaccinated WLHIV. Interventions were delivered at ages 18 or 24 years under standard- and high-coverage assumptions. Outcomes included cervical cancer cases averted, cervical cancer deaths averted among WLHIV, discounted disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) averted, additional physical vaccine doses, and incremental costs from the health-system and vaccination-programme perspectives. Results All six strategies generated additional health gains relative to routine vaccination alone. Mean DALYs averted across countries ranged from 8.21 for booster vaccination at age 24 years to 81.36 for high-coverage combined booster and catch-up vaccination at age 24 years. Booster-only strategies produced the greatest health gains per additional physical vaccine dose, whereas the high-coverage combined strategy at age 24 years produced the largest average absolute health gain. However, the relative performance of vaccination at ages 18 and 24 years varied by strategy and country. From the health-system perspective, 68 of 78 country–strategy comparisons were more effective and less costly than routine vaccination after accounting for avoided cervical cancer treatment costs. From the vaccination-programme perspective, all strategies required additional expenditure. Conclusions HPV vaccination strategies targeting WLHIV generated additional health benefits beyond routine adolescent vaccination and were cost-saving in many country–strategy comparisons when avoided cervical cancer treatment costs were included. Booster-only strategies were the most dose-efficient, whereas combined booster and primary catch-up strategies produced larger absolute health gains. The relative performance of strategies delivered at ages 18 and 24 years was context dependent and should not be interpreted as evidence of a universal advantage of later vaccination. Given the limited direct evidence on the clinical effectiveness and duration of protection following HPV booster vaccination among WLHIV, the booster scenarios should be interpreted as exploratory.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 感染艾滋病毒 (WLHIV) 的女性持续感染 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 和 宫颈癌 的风险增加。本研究旨在评估 13 个非洲国家针对 WLHIV 的 HPV 疫苗接种 策略对终生健康的影响和成本效益。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在 100,000 名女性的封闭 队列研究 中使用了 HPV 感染的年龄结构马尔可夫模型和 宫颈癌,按 HIV 状况进行分层,并针对每个国家将其分别校准为特定年龄的 宫颈癌 发病率、宫颈癌 死亡率 和女性 HIV 患病率。
elements_zh.methods: 使用特定年龄的 宫颈癌 发病率、宫颈癌 死亡率 和女性 HIV 患病率 数据对每个国家的模型进行校准。在标准覆盖率和高覆盖率假设下,干预措施是在 18 岁或 24 岁时实施的。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 14 岁时,将六种针对 HIV 的策略与常规两剂 疫苗接种 进行了比较。与单独的常规 疫苗接种 相比,所有六种策略都产生了额外的健康收益。各国避免的平均 DALY 范围从 24 岁时加强剂 疫苗接种 的 8.21 到 24 岁时高覆盖率联合加强剂和追赶 疫苗接种 的 81.36。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些策略要么为先前接种过的 WLHIV 提供加强剂量,要么为先前接种过的 WLHIV 提供加强剂量,并为先前未接种过疫苗的 WLHIV 提供三剂初级补补课程。单纯加强策略每增加 疫苗 物理剂量就能产生最大的健康收益,而高覆盖率联合策略在 24 岁时产生最大的平均绝对健康收益。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 针对 WLHIV 的 HPV 疫苗接种 策略产生了超出常规青少年 疫苗接种 的额外健康益处,并且在许多国家(当包括避免的 宫颈癌 治疗 成本时)可以节省成本。仅加强剂策略的剂量效率最高,而加强剂和初级追赶策略相结合可产生更大的绝对健康收益。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 鉴于关于 WLHIV 中 HPV 加强疫苗 疫苗接种 的临床有效性和保护持续时间的直接证据有限,加强疫苗方案应被解释为探索性的。18 岁和 24 岁时实施的策略的相对表现取决于具体情况,不应被解释为后来 疫苗接种 的普遍优势的证据。

title: Spatial organization of HPV-associated immune programs across tissue compartments in oropharyngeal cancer
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal cancer (OPC) is characterized by a distinct immune microenvironment; however, the biological significance of immune-related transcriptional programs may vary according to their spatial localization. We investigated the spatial organization of HPV-associated transcriptional programs across anatomically distinct tissue compartments in OPC. METHODS: An oropharynx-restricted The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA)-oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) cohort comprising 77 tumors (51 HPV-positive and 26 HPV-negative) was analyzed using single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA). Spatial transcriptomic profiling using GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiling was evaluated in lymphoid follicular regions (LFRs) and tumor tissue regions (TTRs) from six OPC patients (four HPV-positive and two HPV-negative), with the patient treated as the primary experimental unit. Tumor-free surrounding palatine tonsillar tissue (PTT) was analyzed in an independent microarray cohort comprising 23 HPV-positive and four HPV-negative cases. Eight prespecified immune- and metabolism-related transcriptional programs were evaluated, with additional exploratory cell-type deconvolution and overall survival analyses. RESULTS: In TCGA-OPSCC, all five immune-related programs were higher in HPV-positive tumors, and Stem-like, Tpex, B-cell activity, and T-cell activity remained significantly associated with HPV-positive status after adjustment for clinicopathological covariates and FDR correction. In paired GeoMx analyses, all five immune-related programs were higher in LFRs than in TTRs in all six patients, whereas Estrogen Response Early and Estrogen Response Late were higher in TTRs in all six patients (BH-FDR = 0.0357 for each program). Bile Acid Metabolism showed no consistent compartment-specific difference. HPV-associated differences within individual GeoMx compartments and HPV-by-compartment interactions were not statistically significant after FDR correction. In PTT, immune-related and metabolic programs showed directional HPV-associated differences, but none remained significant after FDR correction. Higher scores for several immune-related programs were associated with improved overall survival in univariable TCGA-OPSCC analyses, but these associations were attenuated after accounting for HPV status. CONCLUSIONS: HPV-associated immune transcriptional programs identified in bulk OPC show consistent spatial organization across lymphoid follicular and tumor tissue compartments. The most robust spatial feature was within-patient compartmentalization between LFRs and TTRs, whereas evidence for HPV-associated differences within individual spatial compartments was limited. These findings emphasize the importance of anatomical context when interpreting transcriptional programs in OPC.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the spatial organization of HPV-associated immune transcriptional programs in oropharyngeal cancer (OPC). It finds that immune-related programs are consistently higher in HPV-positive tumors compared to HPV-negative ones, with significant associations remaining after statistical adjustments. Spatial transcriptomic profiling reveals that immune programs are more active in lymphoid follicular regions (LFRs) than in tumor tissue regions (TTRs) across all six patients, while estrogen response programs are more prevalent in TTRs. However, HPV-associated differences within individual compartments and interactions between HPV and compartments are not statistically significant after FDR correction. The study highlights the importance of anatomical context in interpreting transcriptional programs in OPC, which may have implications for targeted surveillance and treatment strategies. The findings are based on a TCGA-OPSCC cohort and independent microarray analyses, but the evidence for compartment-specific HPV differences is limited, suggesting the need for further research.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: HPV 阳性口咽癌 (OPC) 的特点是具有独特的免疫微环境,但免疫相关转录程序的生物学意义可能因其空间定位而异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 分析了包含 77 个肿瘤(51 个 HPV 阳性和 26 个 HPV 阴性)的 TCGA-OPSCC 队列研究,以及 6 名 OPC 患者(4 名 HPV 阳性和 2 名 HPV 阴性)的空间转录组分析,以及 23 名 HPV 阳性和 4 名 HPV 阴性病例的无肿瘤腭扁桃体组织的独立微阵列 队列研究。
elements_zh.methods: 单样本基因集富集分析 (ssGSEA) 用于评估 TCGA-OPSCC 队列研究 中的免疫相关转录程序。使用 GeoMx 数字空间分析对 6 名 OPC 患者的淋巴滤泡区域 (LFR) 和肿瘤组织区域 (TTR) 进行空间转录组分析,以患者为主要实验单位。评估了八个预先指定的免疫和代谢相关转录程序,包括细胞类型解卷积和总体生存分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 TCGA-OPSCC 中,所有五个免疫相关项目在 HPV 阳性肿瘤中均较高,并且在调整临床病理协变量和 FDR 校正后,四个项目仍与 HPV 阳性状态显着相关。在 GeoMx 分析中,所有 6 名患者的所有五个免疫相关项目的 LFR 均高于 TTR,而早期雌激素反应和晚期雌激素反应的 TTR 较高(每个项目的 BH-FDR = 0.0357)。胆汁酸代谢没有表现出一致的隔室特异性差异。FDR 校正后,各个 GeoMx 区室中 HPV 相关的差异以及 HPV 与区室之间的相互作用没有统计学意义。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在批量 OPC 中鉴定出的 HPV 相关免疫转录程序在淋巴滤泡和肿瘤组织区室中显示出一致的空间组织,其中最强大的空间特征是 LFR 和 TTR 之间的患者内部区室化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了解释 OPC 转录程序时解剖学背景的重要性,这可能为 HPV 相关癌症的 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供更精确的信息。

title_zh: 口咽癌组织区室中 HPV 相关免疫程序的空间组织
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal cancer (OPC) is characterized by a distinct immune microenvironment; however, the biological significance of immune-related transcriptional programs may vary according to their spatial localization. We investigated the spatial organization of HPV-associated transcriptional programs across anatomically distinct tissue compartments in OPC. METHODS: An oropharynx-restricted The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA)-oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) cohort comprising 77 tumors (51 HPV-positive and 26 HPV-negative) was analyzed using single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA). Spatial transcriptomic profiling using GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiling was evaluated in lymphoid follicular regions (LFRs) and tumor tissue regions (TTRs) from six OPC patients (four HPV-positive and two HPV-negative), with the patient treated as the primary experimental unit. Tumor-free surrounding palatine tonsillar tissue (PTT) was analyzed in an independent microarray cohort comprising 23 HPV-positive and four HPV-negative cases. Eight prespecified immune- and metabolism-related transcriptional programs were evaluated, with additional exploratory cell-type deconvolution and overall survival analyses. RESULTS: In TCGA-OPSCC, all five immune-related programs were higher in HPV-positive tumors, and Stem-like, Tpex, B-cell activity, and T-cell activity remained significantly associated with HPV-positive status after adjustment for clinicopathological covariates and FDR correction. In paired GeoMx analyses, all five immune-related programs were higher in LFRs than in TTRs in all six patients, whereas Estrogen Response Early and Estrogen Response Late were higher in TTRs in all six patients (BH-FDR = 0.0357 for each program). Bile Acid Metabolism showed no consistent compartment-specific difference. HPV-associated differences within individual GeoMx compartments and HPV-by-compartment interactions were not statistically significant after FDR correction. In PTT, immune-related and metabolic programs showed directional HPV-associated differences, but none remained significant after FDR correction. Higher scores for several immune-related programs were associated with improved overall survival in univariable TCGA-OPSCC analyses, but these associations were attenuated after accounting for HPV status. CONCLUSIONS: HPV-associated immune transcriptional programs identified in bulk OPC show consistent spatial organization across lymphoid follicular and tumor tissue compartments. The most robust spatial feature was within-patient compartmentalization between LFRs and TTRs, whereas evidence for HPV-associated differences within individual spatial compartments was limited. These findings emphasize the importance of anatomical context when interpreting transcriptional programs in OPC.
abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 阳性口咽癌 (OPC) 的特点是独特的免疫微环境;然而,免疫相关转录程序的生物学意义可能因其空间定位而异。我们研究了 OPC 中解剖学上不同的组织区室中 HPV 相关转录程序的空间组织。方法:使用单样本基因集富集分析 (ssGSEA) 对包含 77 个肿瘤(51 个 HPV 阳性和 26 个 HPV 阴性)的口咽限制癌症 基因组 图谱 (TCGA)-口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 队列研究 进行分析。使用 GeoMx 数字空间分析对六名 OPC 患者(四名 HPV 阳性和两名 HPV 阴性)的淋巴滤泡区域 (LFR) 和肿瘤组织区域 (TTR) 进行空间转录组分析评估,该患者被视为主要实验单位。在独立微阵列 队列研究 中分析无肿瘤周围腭扁桃体组织 (PTT),其中包括 23 例 HPV 阳性病例和 4 例 HPV 阴性病例。评估了八个预先指定的免疫和代谢相关转录程序,并进行了额外的探索性细胞类型解卷积和总体生存分析。结果:在 TCGA-OPSCC 中,所有五个免疫相关项目在 HPV 阳性肿瘤中均较高,并且在调整临床病理协变量和 FDR 校正后,干细胞样、Tpex、B 细胞活性和 T 细胞活性仍然与 HPV 阳性状态显着相关。在配对 GeoMx 分析中,所有 6 名患者的所有 5 个免疫相关项目的 LFR 均高于 TTR,而所有 6 名患者的早期雌激素反应和晚期雌激素反应的 TTR 均较高(每个项目的 BH-FDR = 0.0357)。胆汁酸代谢没有表现出一致的隔室特异性差异。FDR 校正后,各个 GeoMx 区室中 HPV 相关的差异以及 HPV 与区室之间的相互作用没有统计学意义。在 PTT 中,免疫相关和代谢程序显示出与 HPV 相关的定向差异,但在 FDR 校正后没有任何显着差异。在单变量 TCGA-OPSCC 分析中,一些免疫相关项目的得分较高与总体生存率的提高相关,但在考虑 HPV 状态后,这些关联性减弱。结论:在大量 OPC 中鉴定出的 HPV 相关免疫转录程序在淋巴滤泡和肿瘤组织区室中显示出一致的空间组织。最稳健的空间特征是 LFR 和 TTR 之间的患者内部划分,而各个空间划分内 HPV 相关差异的证据有限。这些发现强调了解释 OPC 转录程序时解剖背景的重要性。

title: Host chromatin architecture in HPV-driven cervical cancer: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic resistance
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) is the principal etiologic driver of cervical cancer. However, HPV status and E6/E7-mediated disruption of the p53/RB axis do not fully explain why HPV-associated lesions differ in persistence, malignant progression, therapeutic response, and relapse. This review examines how host chromatin architecture and related transcriptional programs may contribute to the stabilization of malignant cell states following HPV-mediated checkpoint disruption. We discuss evidence linking HPV persistence and integration to epigenetic permissiveness, three-dimensional genome organization, enhancer-promoter rewiring, cohesin dynamics, and WAPL-associated chromatin regulation. Particular attention is given to how these mechanisms may influence MYC/E2F-centered proliferative output and cooperate with context-dependent signaling and tumor microenvironmental adaptation to contribute to treatment tolerance and resistant malignant states. We also consider how chromatin-informed biomarkers, public datasets, perturbation-guided prioritization, authenticated cervical cancer cell lines, organoids, and patient-derived models can be used to evaluate therapeutically relevant vulnerabilities. By integrating viral oncogenesis with host genome regulation and adaptive resistance, this review proposes a conceptual and experimentally testable framework for stratifying HPV-driven cervical cancer and prioritizing candidate intervention nodes.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 持续感染是 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素。然而,HPV 状态和 E6/E7 介导的 p53/RB 轴破坏并不能完全解释为什么 HPV 相关病变在持续性、恶性进展、治疗反应和复发方面存在差异。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述探讨了 宿主 染色质结构和相关转录程序如何有助于 HPV 介导的检查点破坏后恶性细胞状态的稳定。我们讨论了将 HPV 持久性和整合与表观遗传许可性、三维 基因组 组织、增强子-启动子重新布线、粘连蛋白动力学和 WAPL 相关染色质调控联系起来的证据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 通过将病毒肿瘤发生与 宿主 基因组 调节和适应性抵抗相结合,本综述提出了一个概念性和可实验测试的框架,用于对 HPV 驱动的 宫颈癌 进行分层并优先考虑候选干预节点。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 我们还考虑如何使用染色质信息生物标志物、公共数据集、扰动引导优先级、经过验证的 宫颈癌 细胞系、类器官和患者衍生模型来评估治疗相关的脆弱性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 特别关注这些机制如何影响以 MYC/E2F 为中心的增殖输出,并与背景依赖性信号传导和肿瘤微环境适应配合,以促进 治疗 耐受和抵抗恶性状态。

title_zh: HPV 驱动的 宿主 染色质结构 宫颈癌:分子机制和治疗耐药性
source_body_en: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) is the principal etiologic driver of cervical cancer. However, HPV status and E6/E7-mediated disruption of the p53/RB axis do not fully explain why HPV-associated lesions differ in persistence, malignant progression, therapeutic response, and relapse. This review examines how host chromatin architecture and related transcriptional programs may contribute to the stabilization of malignant cell states following HPV-mediated checkpoint disruption. We discuss evidence linking HPV persistence and integration to epigenetic permissiveness, three-dimensional genome organization, enhancer-promoter rewiring, cohesin dynamics, and WAPL-associated chromatin regulation. Particular attention is given to how these mechanisms may influence MYC/E2F-centered proliferative output and cooperate with context-dependent signaling and tumor microenvironmental adaptation to contribute to treatment tolerance and resistant malignant states. We also consider how chromatin-informed biomarkers, public datasets, perturbation-guided prioritization, authenticated cervical cancer cell lines, organoids, and patient-derived models can be used to evaluate therapeutically relevant vulnerabilities. By integrating viral oncogenesis with host genome regulation and adaptive resistance, this review proposes a conceptual and experimentally testable framework for stratifying HPV-driven cervical cancer and prioritizing candidate intervention nodes.
abstract_zh: 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 持续感染是 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素。然而,HPV 状态和 E6/E7 介导的 p53/RB 轴破坏并不能完全解释为什么 HPV 相关病变在持续性、恶性进展、治疗反应和复发方面存在差异。本综述探讨了 宿主 染色质结构和相关转录程序如何有助于 HPV 介导的检查点破坏后恶性细胞状态的稳定。我们讨论了将 HPV 持久性和整合与表观遗传许可性、三维 基因组 组织、增强子-启动子重新布线、粘连蛋白动力学和 WAPL 相关染色质调控联系起来的证据。特别关注这些机制如何影响以 MYC/E2F 为中心的增殖输出,并与背景依赖性信号传导和肿瘤微环境适应配合,以促进 治疗 耐受和抵抗恶性状态。我们还考虑如何使用染色质信息生物标志物、公共数据集、扰动引导优先级、经过验证的 宫颈癌 细胞系、类器官和患者衍生模型来评估治疗相关的脆弱性。通过将病毒肿瘤发生与 宿主 基因组 调节和适应性抵抗相结合,本综述提出了一个概念性和可实验测试的框架,用于对 HPV 驱动的 宫颈癌 进行分层并优先考虑候选干预节点。
